**Job Title:** Senior Performance Engineer

**Location:** London - Hybrid

**Role type:** Permanent

**Security Clearance:**Active SC (Security Clearance) is essential and ideally NPPV3 (eligibility also accepted)

**Who we are:**

We're an award-winning Tech Consultancy, focused on Quality Engineering, on a mission to become the UK's #1.

**What we do:**

"Champion and Engineer Quality and Software". Over the past 6 years, we've shaped and transformed our offering so that passion, precision, and attention to every minuscule detail is baked into everything we do. Born from a desire to bring automation expertise to our current and prospective clients, we've continued to evolve our offering to help organisations build quality into every stage of software delivery.

Proudly certified as a "Great Place to Work", 2i are the chosen employer of around 400 Quality Engineers, and we're continuing our growth! We recently announced our eight-figure private equity funding injection as we aim to increase our revenue by more than £50m in the coming years. That is where you come in...

**The opportunity:**

We're looking for an experienced **Senior Performance Test Engineer** to join our team, bringing expertise across performance and non-functional testing alongside hands-on automation experience.

You'll play a key role in defining and delivering performance testing strategies across complex, cloud-hosted systems, helping ensure applications can meet the scalability, reliability and availability requirements expected of them.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design and execute a wide range of performance tests, investigate bottlenecks across application, infrastructure, database and network layers and use your findings to make practical recommendations that improve system performance and resilience.

You'll also have the opportunity to bring performance testing further into the development lifecycle by building automated performance testing solutions and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines. Working closely with developers, infrastructure teams and other engineers, you'll help establish performance testing as an integral part of modern software delivery rather than something that happens towards the end of a project.

Alongside your technical contribution, you'll provide technical leadership and mentoring to other engineers and testers, help shape performance testing standards and contribute to wider Quality Engineering practices.

**What we're looking for:**

We're looking for someone with significant commercial experience in **performance and non-functional testing**, who enjoys interrogating complex systems to understand how they behave under different conditions.

You'll have a solid understanding of performance testing methodologies and be comfortable designing and executing tests including load, stress, spike, endurance, volume, capacity and resilience testing.

We're looking for someone who can combine this specialist performance expertise with a broader engineering mindset. You'll understand automation, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure and be comfortable working alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to identify and resolve performance issues.

You'll also have the technical confidence to analyse performance from multiple perspectives, understand where bottlenecks may exist and communicate your findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**You'll need to be...**

* **A performance testing specialist.** You'll have significant commercial experience in performance and non-functional testing, with a solid understanding of load, stress, spike, endurance/soak, volume, capacity and resilience testing.
* **An expert in JMeter.** You'll have in depth, hands-on experience using **Apache JMeter** to design, develop and execute performance tests across complex applications.
* **An extensive background with automation.** You'll have experience developing automated performance testing solutions and reusable automation assets using one or more languages such as **Java, Python or JavaScript**.
* **Experienced with AWS.** You'll have strong practical experience working with AWS services including **EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling and Load Balancers**, and understand how cloud architecture influences application performance and scalability.
* **Experienced with Linux/Unix.** You'll be confident troubleshooting Linux/Unix environments and investigating performance issues across application and infrastructure layers.
* **Experienced with CI/CD.** You'll understand how to integrate automated performance testing into **Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines**, helping bring performance validation further into the development lifecycle.
* **Data and metrics driven.** You'll be comfortable analysing performance metrics and using monitoring and observability tooling to identify bottlenecks and understand system behaviour.
* **Experienced with distributed systems.** You'll have worked with **APIs, microservices and distributed architectures**, understanding the challenges they introduce from a performance perspective.
* **Comfortable with monitoring and observability.** Experience with tools such as **Grafana and Prometheus** will be valuable when analysing system performance and identifying bottlenecks.
* **A technical problem solver.** You'll enjoy investigating complex performance issues across application, infrastructure, database and network layers and turning your findings into clear recommendations.
* **A technical leader.** You'll be comfortable mentoring engineers and testers, contributing to testing strategy and establishing performance testing standards and best practices.
* **A confident communicator.** You'll be able to influence technical decisions across multidisciplinary teams and clearly communicate performance risks, findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* **Comfortable working in Agile environments.** You'll understand modern engineering practices and how performance testing fits into an Agile software delivery lifecycle.

**It would be great if you also have...**

* Experience working with **Docker** and containerised environments.
* An understanding of **Infrastructure as Code** principles.
* Exposure to **security and penetration testing** concepts.
* Knowledge of **observability** tooling and **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** principles.

**What we can offer you...**

* Leadership pathways tailored for your personal and professional learning and development within 2i, giving clear direction for your career with us.
* 26 days of annual leave + the option to buy and sell holiday (up to 5 days).
* Private Health Care + access to other mental health and wellbeing services including: Gym Memberships, Counselling, Cycle to Work Schemes + many more.
* Individual and Company related performance bonus up to 10% annually.
* Flexible working in a hybrid environment across the UK!

We don't believe in the "perfect" hire. What we do believe in is the benefits of creating a team built of different perspectives, backgrounds, career paths and ways of working. What we value most are team players who are eager to take their growth into their own hands and utilise the people around them.

**Please note that we cannot accept applicants who require visa sponsorship. We also cannot accept applicants who do not currently possess active SC (Security Clearance).**

## **Who We Are**

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

## **Who You Are**

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:

* Built and shipped production-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably
* Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability
* Delivered on  high-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries

* Led and delivered solutions to architecture-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability

* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

## **What You’ll Do At 8th Light**

As a go-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:

* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform- or product-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

## **Strongly Preferred Skills**

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps & DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.

## **How You’ll be Supported**

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.

* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818-£116,122 GBP

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

* In coordination with Project Leadership, drive the digital and digital delivery agenda on projects.

* Maintain accountability records (issue logs, audit results, deliverable status) that give the project leadership clear visibility into project performance.

* Conduct regular model reviews and compliance checks across all delivery locations.
* Report on BIM KPIs, compliance metrics, and deliverable status to project leadership through supporting dashboards.

**Automation & Technical Enablement**

* Identify Innovation, Automation, AI opportunities within all aspects of project delivery.
* In collaboration with AECOM's Digital team, determine suitable route for Innovation, Automation, AI development.
* Support asset information management (AIM) and digital handover for facilities management and digital-twin environments where required.

* Provide input to bids and resource schedules.
* Provide support to junior staff on digital delivery and development.
* Capture lessons learned and recurring deficiency patterns to refine workflows and inform project leadership.
* Share best practices, standards, tools, and techniques with the broader Digital team.

**Here’s what we’re looking for**

* Excellent communication skills and leadership in digital management.
* Persistence, initiative, attention to detail, and sound judgement.
* Effective time management, flexibility, and openness to change.
* Capability to manage project timescales and advise on fee allocation or resources.
* Proven track record in leading information management for large infrastructure projects
* Experience managing multidisciplinary Buildings projects with geographically dispersed teams
* Knowledge of managing BIM throughout the entire project lifecycle, from design to construction and handover.
* Proficiency in IM and implementing industry standards like ISO 19650 on projects.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Forma, and other CDE solutions.
* Experience with data management and integration tools.
* Experience in project delivery, stakeholder coordination, and documentation.
* Proven ability to engage with various stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Skills in resolving conflicts that may arise during project execution.
* Strong data skills, including data governance and ability to use PowerBI to convey key project information to stakeholders.
* Interest or experience in integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into BIM and digital-delivery workflows.

Aflac is building the specialist capability required to create better customer and partner experiences, strengthen our enterprise cloud and data foundations, and deliver modern digital products safely and responsibly. Within Digital Services, we are looking for a senior, hands-on product leader who will lead and coach a small team experienced Product Managers while personally shaping a new API-led model with Benefits Administration partners. The initial focus will be modernising enrolment, but the ambition is broader: creating reusable integration capabilities, partner propositions and onboarding models that can support multiple products and customer journeys over time. If that sounds like the kind of challenge you enjoy, keep reading. Team Context We are building outcome-driven product capabilities within a modern Product Operating Model. Product teams work across customer experience, integrations, data and enterprise platforms, bringing Product, Engineering, Architecture, UX and business expertise together around measurable outcomes. The market is moving towards more direct, API-enabled connections between insurers and Benefits Administration providers. Our opportunity is to make it faster and easier for partners, employers and brokers to work with Aflac, while improving data quality, reducing manual effort and creating a model that can scale. This role will sit at the centre of that opportunity. You will help shape how we work with Benefits Administration partners, how our integration capabilities evolve, and how we take a stronger partner proposition to market. You will also lead a small group of experienced Product Managers working across different but complementary areas of integrations and enrolment. Role Context
In this role leading Product for Integrations & Enrolment, you will own the overall partner and integration product strategy, product proposition, measurable outcomes and major investment trade-offs in partnership with business sponsors and Architecture. This is a genuine player-coach role. Approximately 70% of your time will initially be focused on hands-on product leadership, with around 30% focused on leading and coaching the team. That balance may evolve as the partner model and team mature. You will work directly with Benefits Administration/HR providers across product discovery, technical alignment, partner onboarding and ongoing product relationships. You will connect market insight, business strategy and technical possibilities to decide what we should build, what we should not build, and where investment can create the greatest value. What you’ll be doing Own and evolve the product strategy for integrations and enrolment, connecting partner needs, Aflac strategy and market direction to measurable business outcomes. Shape a new API-led model with Benefits Administration/HR partners, combining partner APIs, shared platform capabilities, a repeatable onboarding model and a wider digital enrolment proposition. Work with executive stakeholders and business sponsors to determine how we go to market, communicate the product proposition and make clear investment and sequencing decisions. Lead discovery directly with partners, employers, brokers, internal users and subject-matter experts to uncover high-value problems and test assumptions. Partner closely with Engineering, UX Architecture to make informed trade-offs across partner-specific needs, reusable capabilities, scalability, security, reliability and speed to market. Create a coherent roadmap across integrations and enrolment, ensuring the work of individual Product Managers contributes to a shared strategy and avoids fragmented point solutions. Define and track outcomes across implementation time, manual effort, data quality, partner experience, operating cost, scalability, adoption and speed to market. Use qualitative and quantitative evidence, including research, analytics, experiments, prototypes and partner feedback, to guide product decisions and demonstrate realised value. Lead, coach and develop small group of Product Managers from the outset, strengthening their judgement across discovery, prioritisation, measurement and stakeholder leadership. Remove organisational blockers, manage dependencies and risks, and build productive relationships across Product, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Security, Compliance, Data and business teams. Champion outcome-driven product thinking, continuous discovery and continuous improvement across the wider Product community. It is your judgement, curiosity and ability to create outcomes that we are really interested in. Essential criteria Five or more years of relevant product management experience in a digital environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Demonstrable experience as a senior Product leadership role or equivalent, owning strategy across a complex product area. Experience with B2B, B2B2C, platform, data, API, ecosystem or partner-integrated products. Evidence of leading product strategy, discovery and delivery, rather than specialising in only one stage of the product lifecycle. Experience working with executive stakeholders and helping shape product propositions, go-to-market choices, priorities and investment trade-offs. Experience coaching Product Managers and improving the quality of product thinking and decision-making around you. Strong product discovery capability, including partner or customer interviews, journey mapping, workshop facilitation, hypothesis testing, experimentation and prioritisation. Ability to define measurable outcomes and connect customer or partner problems to economic value, operating cost, risk, adoption and strategic fit. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain the why, simplify complexity and translate effectively between commercial, operational and technical audiences. Confidence operating in ambiguity, challenging assumptions and making evidence-based decisions about what should and should not be built. Desirable criteria Experience in Benefits Administration, HR technology, payroll, employee benefits, insurance or another regulated and data-sensitive environment. Consultancy or advisory experience combined with evidence of remaining accountable through implementation and measurable outcomes. Technical credibility across API products, data exchange, integration patterns, platform reuse, partner onboarding, reliability and security. You do not need to be an architect, but ideally you would make sound product trade-offs with Engineering and Architecture. Experience creating external partner propositions, onboarding models or ecosystem strategies. Experience managing or leading multiple related products, roadmaps or product teams. Experience with product analytics, dashboards or business intelligence tools used to baseline performance, measure adoption and demonstrate value. Understanding of cloud platforms, API lifecycle management, integration platforms, systems of record, systems of truth or service orchestration. Please note that this is not a remote role. About Us & Locations
The Flight Physics domain is at the core of aircraft architecture and system integration. Within our team, we develop, maintain, and advance our internal in-house simulation software for aircraft loads & aeroelastics.
You will ideally be working in Hamburg, the largest production site for civil aircraft. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe offers unique perks, such as the option to commute by ferry, allowing you to experience the special flair of Hamburg where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets maritime legacy.
As our team operates across international engineering hubs, Bremen (Germany) and Filton (UK) are also possible locations for this role. Across all sites, close collaboration and team spirit are central to how we work, which is why regular on-site presence at your chosen location is required.
Your Mission
You will be a key developer for our internal loads simulation software. In this role, you will bridge the gap between flight physics domain knowledge and software engineering. You will participate in all phases of the software lifecycle—from defining simulation requirements and architectural design to implementation, automated testing, and deployment. Your code will directly enable engineering teams across Airbus to calculate and evaluate aircraft loads accurately and efficiently.
Our Benefits for You
Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
Your tasks and responsibilities
In-House Simulation Tool Development: Design, code, test, deploy, and continuously enhance our internal simulation software dedicated to aircraft loads and aeroelastics.
Algorithm & Architecture Design: Implement advanced numerical methods and physical models into clean, high-performance, and modular code.
Requirements Translation: Collaborate closely with Flight Physics loads engineers to translate complex aerodynamic and structural load requirements into efficient software algorithms.
User Support & Tool Maintenance: Provide technical support to internal engineering users, troubleshoot simulation issues, and optimize software performance and usability based on user feedback.
Engineering Best Practices: Apply modern software engineering standards, including peer code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and comprehensive testing to ensure simulation accuracy and code reliability.
Desired skills and qualifications
Domain Background: Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautics, Computational Engineering, Physics, or a related field with a solid understanding of flight physics, aircraft loads, or structural mechanics.
Hands-on Programming Skills: Strong coding abilities and solid experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) using Python, C++, or C#.
Systems & Infrastructure: Experience working in Linux environments. Practical knowledge of High-Performance Computing (HPC), parallel computing, or aeroelastic simulation workflows is a major advantage.
Software Engineering Practice: Solid foundation in modern development workflows, including Git/version control, unit testing, and CI/CD practices.
Problem-Solving & Mindset: A passion for translating physical engineering problems into robust, automated software tools.
Communication & Team Spirit: Excellent communication skills in English, good Level of German speaking with an open, collaborative approach to working in an international engineering team.

* Oversee second line regional SAR/STR/SMR reporting teams in performance of L3 review and preparation of suspicious activity reports according to relevant requirements, in coordination with regional and local MLROs.
* Oversee the second line global Financial Intelligence Unit in performance of complex investigations, including cross-regional reviews, internal and external referrals, intelligence scanning and emerging risk typology development.
* Collaborate with the FCC Global Models lead on performance of appropriate governance of the global Transaction Monitoring rule lifecycle, covering typology identification, scenario logic, segmentation, threshold tuning, and above- and below-the-line testing across cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts.
* Lead the evolution from threshold-based monitoring towards AI-driven anomaly detection, machine-learning behavioural clustering and automated alert triage while maintaining explainability and regulatory defensibility.
* Partner with Product, Data Science and Engineering to embed Transaction Monitoring logic into core transaction-processing systems and real-time payment infrastructure.
* Resolve complex financial crime escalations, including novel laundering schemes, sanctions-evasion typologies and complex Suspicious Activity Report (SAR / STR) decisions.
* Improve model effectiveness by partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams and Audit to validate Transaction Monitoring models and maintain coverage mapping against global regulatory standards.
* Represent Airwallex’s Transaction Monitoring programme in regulatory examinations, including FCA, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC reviews, as well as partner-bank due diligence.

### Essentials

* 10+ years of dedicated AML and financial crime experience, with deep technical and operational expertise in Transaction Monitoring across global cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms.

* Proven experience establishing 2LOD oversight frameworks, rule-governance processes and effective challenge mechanisms for high-volume, automated Transaction Monitoring platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets, SQL, data analytics and modern Transaction Monitoring models, translating business logic into technical parameters for Data Science and Engineering teams.
* Practical experience evaluating, testing or deploying AI/ML tools, graph analytics or automated dispositioning models in a regulatory compliance environment.
* Strong understanding of global AML rules, typology standards and reporting expectations across key regulators, including FCA, FinCEN, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC.
* A proven track record of managing regulatory examinations, internal or external audits and banking-partner inquiries relating to Transaction Monitoring systems and controls.
* Exceptional stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative Transaction Monitoring models and risk decisions clearly to senior executives and external authorities.
* Based in the UK, ideally within reach of Birmingham, with the agility to collaborate across APAC, EMEA and Americas time zones.
* CAMS, CFCS, CFE or equivalent industry certification.
* A bachelor’s degree.

### Preferred

* A quantitative, technical, data or legal degree.
* Experience working across high-volume cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms.
* Experience partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams, Product, Data Science, Engineering and Audit.

The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. * Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.

# Aon Industrial Placement Programme 2027 - Marketing and Communications

**Marketing and Communications – Industrial Placement Programme 2027**

**Start Date: 1st September 2027**

**Application closing date: 7th December 2026***Please note, we may close earlier if we receive the quantity, quality & variety of applications required.*

**Better Decisions Begin with You**

Aon shapes decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. When you join us, you’ll become empowered to make the same impact, as you explore ways of becoming a more relevant, connected and valued professional.

**Your role as a Marketing and Communications Industrial Placement**

Join Aon and spend 12 months discovering the extensive variety of roles that exist within our team. Working in an innovative and upbeat environment, no two days are the same. You’ll gain hands-on experience in the wide number of roles, from Internal Communications and Media Relations to Campaigns, Insights, Brand and Events.

**What the day could look like**

* Working with a Campaign Activation Manager to brief Aon’s digital agency on demand programmes across paid LinkedIn, Facebook, Google Search and content syndication. Use clear prompts to tailor AI-assisted briefs to requirements and campaign goals, explore approaches and deliver agreed actions supporting client objectives.
* Listening to business partners and bringing colleagues together to respond to their growth priorities and client needs. Use industry and risk context to check AI-generated insights for accuracy and relevance before offering guidance or conclusions.
* Helping deliver an Aon event for 100 clients, collaborating with internal partners, valuing different perspectives and challenging assumptions so everyone can contribute. Coordinate AI tools, global delivery resources and colleagues in an integrated workflow, identifying process improvements.
* Supporting a Campaign Manager to plan campaigns and map customer journeys, anticipating needs and aligning priorities with wider goals. Communicate clearly and build foundational skills in Copilot, data analysis systems and digital efficiency tools
* Communicating with more than 6,000 UK employees, using AI-assisted drafting and refined prompts to suit the audience and business objectives. Apply feedback and attention to detail, support others’ development and build trust through clear, consistent delivery.
* Working with Media Relations and PR agencies on press releases and media enquiries. Analyse information, challenge assumptions and identify root causes to solve problems, critically checking AI outputs for anomalies and understanding when human insight should override automation.

**Your Development**

During our Industrial placement, you will join our award-winning development programme. Over 12 months, you can take part in many insightful and interactive training activities alongside your role. Here are couple of key elements of our development programme:

* *Business learning.* On the job learning and experiences enabling you to develop your knowledge and understanding of your team and solution line
* *Centralised learning.* UK graduates complete an Aon Induction, monthly webinars, business skills training, and workshops. These are crafted to improve your understanding of Aon, build your confidence, and expand your connections throughout our business.
* *Feedback.* Upon starting your Aon placement, you will meet with your line manager to discuss your goals. Over your 12-month programme, you will receive feedback and support.

**Your career beyond your Industrial Placement**

Our Placement programme is designed as a potential first step toward a long-term career with us. Your performance during your Placement may lead to an offer for a place on our graduate programme in the same business unit the following year. We encourage you to apply for a Placement that aligns with your long-term interests and career ambitions. By choosing a role that matches your aspirations, you’ll be better positioned to take full advantage of our Launch development programme which offers ongoing career growth.

**Next Steps**

If you are interested in this programme and would like to apply, here is some useful information:

**Entry Requirements:**

* On track to achieve a 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in any degree subject (ideally marketing, communications, or a general business subject area)
* To ensure compliance with UK law, successful candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK throughout the duration of their time in role.

**What are we looking for?**

* **Motivation and ambition to pursue a career in Marketing and Communications.** To clearly articulate your reasons for joining this role at Aon and how clear communication and collaboration support effective campaigns, content and events
* **Passion and curiosity.** We are looking for candidates eager to learn, open to feedback, and interested in understanding our work. They should show AI Literacy with basic skills in AI-enabled technologies, including Copilot, analytics platforms, and tools that improve digital efficiency.
* **Commercial awareness.** Understand client needs, industry developments and risk context and demonstrate Business Context Translation by applying this understanding to validate AI-generated insights before they inform recommendations or decisions. This helps us to provide support and advice to our clients with clarity and confidence to enable revenue growth
* **Using AI effectively.** Develop and polish prompts to adapt AI-generated content for the target market and business requirements. Verify outputs for accuracy. Understand when human judgement is necessary. Identify ways AI can improve work processes.

**Locations**

**We have graduate opportunities this year in the following locations: London**

We recognise the value for our Early Career colleagues of being present at the workplace from the beginning of their programme. As a new industrial placement, the first 6 months will be spent based in the office to support your learning, development, and progression. This will enable you access to support from managers, collaborate with colleagues as well as grow your network across Aon. Once you complete the initial training, you can work with more flexibility. You will spend a minimum of 3 to 4 days face to face in the Aon office or with clients.

**Due to the nature of the work, there may be occasions where you are required to travel in the UK and work outside of your normal working hours to support with events or projects.**

**Aon UK Industrial Placement Recruitment: What to Expect**

We know applying for your first industrial placement role can be exciting, and sometimes a little daunting. At Aon, we’re committed to making our recruitment process as transparent and supportive as possible. Here’s how our selection journey works, and what you can expect at each stage:

1. **Application Review**

* We process applications on a rolling basis, moving candidates forward as they complete each stage.
* Every application is carefully reviewed by our team (not by AI).
* Due to the high volume of interest, this stage can take up to two weeks.
* Please note: We do not review CVs or cover letters at this point.

**2. Online Assessment**

* We understand you want to put your best foot forward, allowing you 5 calendar days to complete the online assessment.
* If you need more time, just let us know as extensions are available.

**3. Video Interview**

* Preparation matters, so you’ll have up to 10 days (240 hours) from receiving your invitation to record and submit your video interview.
* Rest assured: Every video interview is reviewed by a real member of our hiring team, not an AI system.
* You’ll typically hear back from us within 2-3 weeks after submitting your interview, though times may vary depending on how many applications we receive.

**4. Assessment Centres**

* Our assessment centres are held in person at the Aon site closest to the location you applied for.
* Please note: Due to the large number of applications, not every candidate who completes a video interview will be invited to an assessment centre.
* Assessment centres usually run after Christmas, from mid-January.
* If selected, a notice period of 7-14 days will be provided to help you arrange any travel.
* We run a limited number of Assessment Centre so please make every effort to attend if invited.
* We reimburse reasonable travel costs (such as standard class train tickets). Flights and hotels are only covered if agreed in advance.
* At the assessment centre stage, your CV and cover letter will be shared with hiring managers. This helps them get a fuller picture of you as a candidate—but these documents are not used for initial screening.

**What is Aon's guidance of the use of AI during the selection process?**

As an innovative global leader, we recognize and embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help job seekers be more efficient in their recruitment processes. In fact, Aon is in the business of developing and implementing innovative AI tools that support both colleagues and clients, which you’ll use as an Aon colleague if you join our team.

AI can be a helpful tool for researching Aon, preparing for interviews or refining your CV, it should support, not replace, your own thinking, judgement, skills and experiences. Any application materials you submit should accurately reflect your achievements, capabilities and potential.

We ask that you refrain from using AI when completing assessments or during live or pre-recorded interview processes, which will often include an in-person interview where the technology will not be available to you. Additionally, virtual or in-person interviews should not be recorded or transcribed.

At Aon, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, fairness and transparency. We expect all candidates to embrace these principles in every interaction with us.

**Can I apply for more than one programme or role?**

We ask candidates to submit one Early Carers application per recruitment cycle. We encourage you to explore our opportunities carefully and apply for the programme or role that best matches your skills, passions, and professional aspirations. This helps you focus on submitting your strongest application and ensures we can assess candidates fairly and efficiently.

If, during the hiring process, we believe another opportunity at Aon suits your experience and goals better, our recruitment team may talk to you about other options. If you're unsure which programme is right for you, we recommend reviewing the programme information on our careers site or attending one of our events before applying.

Top Tip: Choose the role you're most excited about, rather than treating a second application as a back-up option. We want to understand where your genuine interests lie and how you see your future career developing.

**We’re here to support you every step of the way. If you have any questions or need accommodations, just contact our team - graduates@aon.co.uk. Good luck, and we look forward to seeing what you can bring to Aon!**

**Position Overview**

Autodesk is building industry foundation models for the future of design and make. This role helps define how we measure progress, understand our capability relative to the market, and connect that work to business priorities.

  

You will set priorities for Autodesk's AI benchmarking program, which measures how our capabilities perform on the work that matters most in real world design and manufacturing, against frontier models, competitor technology, and industry baselines. You will interpret those results and turn them into guidance for research, product, and investment decisions. You will work with AI benchmarking engineers, researchers, and business leadership, with visibility up to C-suite.

  

Benchmarking is a key input to business decision making at Autodesk. Demand for this work is high and growing, internally and externally. Your job is to make sure the investment in benchmarking gives leaders a clear view of capability, competitive position, and where to focus next.

  

The person who succeeds here needs to be comfortable working across technical, customer, and business questions. You do not need to build or run the evaluations yourself. You do need enough technical fluency to challenge what is being measured, enough direct work with industry product managers to know where customer value is actually being delivered and whether a measured improvement is one customers recognize, and the judgment to turn both into a clear point of view for leaders making investment decisions.

  

This is an individual contributor role with a path to people management.

  

## Responsibilities

### Capability

* Own and keep current how we prioritize what gets benchmarked, weighing workflow value, strategic importance, and competitive relevance
* Map benchmark priorities to Industry Cloud problem areas and judge what level of evidence each question requires
* Define the comparison set evaluated against those priorities, covering Autodesk and external alternatives
* Collaborate on evolution of relevant human metrics and comparisons
* Turn benchmark results into clear read-outs on Autodesk capability relative to frontier models, competitor technology, and industry baselines, including for the C-suite
* Evolve the channels and cadence through which we report capability and competitive position
* Keep capability questions moving to answers on a timeline that matches the decisions they support, including work that depends on teams you do not manage
* Partner closely with the technical benchmarking team, which owns task curation and evaluation, to shape what gets measured next

  

### Value

* Own the translation from capability to business value
* Evolve how we measure ROI for our models
* Take a capability improvement and connect it to the workflow it changes, the customers it affects, and the revenue or cost implications
* Own the customer and industry validation standard we use to evaluate new business bets
* Work with industry product teams to ground what we measure in the workflows their customers run, and to confirm that a measured improvement is one customers recognize and value
* Reconcile benchmark evidence with customer evidence when the two disagree, and determine which should carry the decision

  

### Competitive

* Turn comparative results into a clear view of how Autodesk capabilities are evolving relative to the market, and set the priorities competitive research works against
* Translate meaningful differences in capability into research questions and investment recommendations with AI Research and AI Economics, informing scenario planning and build versus partner decisions

  

## Minimum qualifications

* 7+ years across strategy consulting, corporate or business strategy, technical product management, AI strategy, applied research, competitive intelligence, or related roles
* **Evaluation fluency.** You can interrogate an evaluation result, challenge the metric, and determine whether a benchmark supports the conclusion being drawn from it
* **Business translation.** You can take a change in capability and work through what it means for a workflow, a customer, a competitor, and ultimately a business decision
* **Structured problem solving.** You are comfortable taking an ambiguous question, breaking it into the right components, working with incomplete evidence, and developing a defensible point of view
* **Movement between technical and business contexts.** You can work credibly with researchers and engineers, then translate the relevant implications for executives without losing the substance
* **Momentum.** You bring a working rhythm that others can plan around, and you help shorten the distance between a question being raised and an answer being available
* Track record of influencing research, product, or investment priorities without direct authority
* Strong analytical judgment and clear, concise executive communication
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

* Experience in strategy consulting, product strategy, or another role requiring structured analysis of complex technical or market questions
* Experience using technical evidence, including benchmarks or evaluations, to inform product, research, or investment decisions
* Experience with competitive intelligence, scenario planning, or technology landscape analysis
* Familiarity with AI model evaluation or benchmarking. Direct hands-on experience is highly valuable but not required
* Experience with unit economics, adoption modeling, or ROI analysis
* Familiarity with Autodesk industries
* Experience leading or mentoring analysts

### **About us**

You've probably heard of Autotrader, but do you know what we're all about?

We're the most trusted, most visited automotive marketplace in the UK. A heritage brand and a tech innovator. We bring together vehicle buyers and sellers to give them real choices. Cars may be what we're best known for but we’re also the place for pretty much everything else on wheels, from e-bikes to caravans.

At our core, we’re all about people. We go our own way while embracing diversity and celebrating our differences. We dedicate ourselves to the idea that we work better together. 

Autotrader is a beautiful, surprising and vibrant place to work. We might not be for everyone, but we could be perfect for you.

At Autotrader, we’re building a best-in-class performance marketing capability. We’re looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to join our growing team, specifically focusing on acquisition and engagement across multiple product areas. You will shape how we grow and retain our user base through innovative, data-driven marketing across core performance channels. 

As the marketing expert for multiple product areas, you’ll lead our digital performance strategies and design campaigns that deliver full-funnel results, from awareness to retention. You’ll own planning, forecasting, and budget allocation, using a hands-on approach to test and optimise our targeting, messaging, and channel mix to maximize ROI. 

This role sits right at the intersection of several business functions. You’ll act as the key link between Product, Content, and Brand teams, while working cross-functionally with CRM, SEO, data, engineering, and external agency partners to keep everyone aligned around a shared, commercially driven growth strategy. 

You’ll also turn complex data into actionable strategies. By championing advanced measurement and attribution frameworks, you’ll ensure every campaign optimisation and budget decision is backed by clear insights that reflect real business outcomes. This is a highly collaborative, commercial role with a real opportunity to influence strategy at a senior level and shape the future of growth at Autotrader. 

**What we’re looking for**

* Practical and hands-on with a strong problem-solving mentality.

# Enterprise Account Director

United Kingdon - London

**Who We Are:**

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on,*the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.*And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? **#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

Bandwidth is looking for an Account Director to own new business revenue within the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem. This is an individual contributor, new logo role - built for a commercially aggressive hunter who thrives on closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

At its core, this role exists because of a strategic partnership. Bandwidth is the first Preferred and Certified Carrier for Salesforce Native Contact Center internationally, so Salesforce enterprise AEs direct customers with BYOC telephony requirements to Bandwidth. The Account Director will own that inbound pipeline and convert it, while simultaneously self-sourcing additional new business.

This role also involves working alongside channel partners in B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's carrier capability is required to complete the solution. This is a collaboration motion, not a channel management role - the AD works with partners to close specific deals, not to recruit or develop the partner base.

The right candidate brings 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, credibility within the Salesforce or CCaaS ecosystem, and the commercial instinct to operate across a dual motion: partner-referred inbound and self-sourced outbound. You should be as comfortable working alongside a Salesforce AE on a joint pursuit as you are prospecting independently into a target account.

**What You'll Do:**

**New Business Pipeline & Conversion**

* Own the full new business sales cycle for Salesforce Native Contact Center BYOC opportunities — from initial qualification through commercial structuring, negotiation, and contractual close
* Manage and convert inbound pipeline referred by Salesforce AEs, maintaining deal velocity and ensuring Bandwidth is positioned correctly at each stage of the customer's evaluation process
* Self-source additional new logo pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts operating within or adjacent to the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem
* Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with strong CRM hygiene; manage forecasting and deal progression with the discipline expected at Account Director level of commercial engagement
* Execute against individual revenue targets spanning both Salesforce-referred and directly sourced new business

**Salesforce Partnership Collaboration**

* Build trusted, day-to-day working relationships with Salesforce enterprise AEs and their management - becoming the go-to Bandwidth contact for BYOC opportunities within their accounts
* Participate in joint account planning with Salesforce sellers, helping map enterprise accounts with BYOC requirements and aligning on pursuit strategy
* Engage Salesforce alliance and partnership contacts as needed to maintain commercial alignment and ensure inbound lead quality improves over time
* Represent Bandwidth credibly in joint customer meetings alongside Salesforce - operating as a senior commercial peer, not a subcontractor

**Channel Partner Collaboration on Enterprise Deals**

* Work alongside channel partners - including MSPs, SIs and Salesforce implementation partners - on B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's BYOC carrier capability is part of the solution they are delivering
* Support channel-led pursuits by providing Bandwidth's commercial, technical and contractual expertise at the appropriate point in the deal cycle
* Ensure deal economics are structured correctly in partner-involved transactions, with clear accountability for Bandwidth's revenue and obligations
* Maintain strong working relationships with key channel partner contacts on active deals, providing the senior Bandwidth commercial presence they need to close

**Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership**

* Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across CIO, CTO, VP of CX, operations and procurement - positioning Bandwidth as a strategic infrastructure partner for their Salesforce Contact Center deployment
* Lead commercial negotiations on high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements, working across legal, security, finance and procurement to reach close
* Orchestrate internal Bandwidth resources - Solutions Engineering, Legal, Product, Finance and Operations - around complex deals without losing deal momentum
* Operate comfortably across large enterprise and complex mid-market deal sizes, adjusting commercial approach and engagement model appropriately

**Market Intelligence & Commercial Feedback**

* Maintain a strong and current understanding of the Salesforce Native Contact Center landscape - how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt it, where BYOC fits into the decision, and what objections Bandwidth regularly faces
* Provide commercial and competitive insight back to Bandwidth's product and GTM teams - surfacing patterns from the Salesforce channel and direct deals that should inform positioning and product direction
* Stay informed on competitive dynamics across BYOC, CPaaS and CCaaS so you can position Bandwidth accurately and confidently in contested opportunities

**What You Need:**

* 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience - with a consistent, verifiable track record of closing six- and seven-figure ARR new logo deals in competitive, technically complex markets
* Demonstrable experience operating in or alongside the Salesforce ecosystem - whether through co-sell motions with Salesforce AEs, selling into Salesforce-driven transformation programmes, or selling solutions that integrate with or complement Salesforce Contact Center or Service Cloud
* + Ability to build relationships at C-suite and VP level across IT, operations, procurement and CX functions, with the executive presence to represent Bandwidth as a senior commercial peer
  + Commercial acumen and deal-structuring capability to lead complex multi-stakeholder negotiations, including multi-party agreements involving channel partners
  + Strong pipeline and forecast discipline — comfortable managing a multi-source revenue target across Salesforce-referred inbound and self-sourced pipeline with full visibility and accuracy

# Senior Product Manager – UK

UK New Product Development Full-time

**Senior Product Manager**

**Role Overview – A senior technical role leading the development and quality of low-voltage switchgear portfolio, combining hands-on electrical design expertise with product ownership, international supplier collaboration and the opportunity to build and lead an engineering team as the business grows.**

This is a key senior appointment for **Bex Group** and represents a genuine opportunity to shape the future of the product function. The Senior Product Manager will take ownership of a critical and growing low-voltage switchgear portfolio and will play a central role in strengthening product development, technical governance and quality capability across the business.

As Bex Group continues to scale, this role is expected to evolve into a broader leadership position, with responsibility for building and developing a product and engineering team over time. The successful candidate will therefore combine strong hands-on technical capability with the credibility and ambition to lead, mentor and set technical standards.

The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development and quality, working closely with Sales, Purchasing, Marketing and Finance teams across the UK, Ireland and China, as well as with global suppliers and manufacturing partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

▪ Lead the design and development of low-voltage switchgear products, ensuring full compliance with relevant standards and regulations

▪ Produce detailed electrical schematics, layouts and technical specifications

▪ Own the selection, integration and functional performance of power and control system components

▪ Provide technical leadership and subject-matter expertise across the organisation

▪ Work closely with electrical and mechanical teams to ensure products meet specification and performance requirements

▪ Manage new product development timelines and ensure design milestones are achieved

▪ Conduct and lead design reviews, identifying opportunities for optimisation and improvement

▪ Troubleshoot and resolve electrical design issues during development and testing

▪ Create and maintain comprehensive design documentation, including test plans, reports and specifications

▪ Liaise with global suppliers to support development, quality assurance and delivery

▪ Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture

▪ Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies and best practice

▪ Live and promote BEX Group values in all aspects of the role

**Candidate Profile – Essential Experience and Skills**

▪ Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline

▪ Minimum of 5 years’ experience in electrical design of low-voltage switchgear

▪ Proven experience working with external manufacturing partners

▪ Strong knowledge of relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements

▪ Proficiency in CAD and electrical design tools

▪ Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office

▪ Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

▪ Excellent problem-solving ability and attention to detail

▪ Confident communicator, comfortable working cross-functionally and internationally

**Personal Attributes**

▪ Practical, solutions-oriented mindset

▪ High standards around quality and documentation

▪ Collaborative and supportive leadership style

▪ Commercially aware, with an appreciation of product cost, margin and manufacturability

▪ Self-directed, resilient and comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong product leader to join a market-leading UK engineering brand at an exciting stage of its growth. Bex Group offers genuine scope for influence and ownership, with the opportunity to shape products that are already well regarded by contractors and wholesalers across the UK.

The role will appeal to someone who enjoys being close to the engineering detail but who also wants broader product responsibility, supplier exposure and leadership scope.

For the right individual, this position offers clear progression within the wider LED Group as the business continues to scale under strong private equity backing.

**Please send CV and Cover Letter to Careers@bexgroup.com**

### Posted on 19/10/2026

* ## The opportunity
* Lead some of the UK’s most iconic fundraising events, creating memorable experiences for thousands of supporters and raising vital funds to support research into heart and circulatory diseases.

  From the London Marathon to the Great North Run, you’ll bring high-profile third-party mass participation events to life for people fundraising for the BHF. Through clear strategy, creative supporter stewardship and seamless event day delivery, you’ll help make every experience count.

  Working closely with the Senior Product Manager, you’ll shape long-term plans, improve performance and identify opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll lead and support the full product journey, from planning and marketing to supporter engagement, event-day delivery and evaluation, making every touchpoint count.

  **What you’ll do**

  + Lead the end-to-end delivery of mass participation events
  + Use data and insight to improve performance and increase income
  + Develop supporter experiences that increase engagement, retention and value
  + Oversee budgets and provide clear reporting against KPIs
  + Manage and support our Senior Product Executive
  + Work collaboratively with teams across the organisation, as well as partners and suppliers

  **About you**

  As our ideal candidate, you’ll have proven experience of developing and delivering a portfolio of successful mass participation events, with a strong understanding of what drives supporter engagement, income and long-term growth.

  You’ll have managed complex projects across the full product lifecycle, from initial concept and planning through to marketing, event delivery and evaluation.

  Your experience will include using customer, market and financial insight to shape product plans, improve performance and maximise return. You’ll also have developed multi-channel campaigns and supporter journeys that deliver measurable results.

  You’ll be experienced in managing budgets and KPIs, coordinating multiple stakeholders and working effectively with internal teams, external partners and suppliers. Previous line management experience would also be valuable.

  **Working arrangements**

  This a fixed term contract until November 2027 covering a secondment.  
    
  This is a hybrid role, where your work will be split between your home and at least one day per week, on average, in our London Office. This may vary from time to time, so you will need to work in a flexible way to unlock your best work for our cause.

  There will be a requirement for flexible out of hours working to support occasional evening and weekend activity. You will be compensated for this with time off in lieu.

## Technical, Quality & Compliance Lead - Gifting (Food, Drink, Home & Lifestyle)

Apply for this job

Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.

We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B CorpTM – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.

Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.

**🛠️****Procurement Team @ Bloom & Wild Group**

You’ll be joining the engine room of Bloom & Wild’s fastest-growing categories. While we are known for our flowers, our Procurement & Technical team owns end-to-end management of our non-horticultural range: from fresh-baked treats, chocolate and drinks to candles, home and lifestyle gifts.

As our gifting range grows, and more of it is our own brand, we’re expanding the team to bring technical expertise in-house alongside our Strategic Procurement and Supply Chain pillars. As our first dedicated technical hire for gifting, you’ll report to the Head of Procurement & Inventory and be the technical lead for every non-floral product we sell. The role is primarily UK-focused, with a smaller remit supporting our other European markets.

You’ll work closely with our Range, Strategic Procurement, Supply Chain, Brand and Warehouse teams, as well as our on-site quality team. This is a rare opportunity to build a technical function from the ground up and see your work directly protect our customers and our brand as we scale.

### ⚙️ What you'll be doing:

* **Own Non-flower Quality & Compliance End-to-End:** Be the technical lead for all our non-horticultural and add-on products, e.g. Food & Drink, Candles & Home Accessories, Pamper Products, Textiles. Define our requirements and standards based on product risk and proactively flag risks before they reach customers.
* **Build the Framework:** You’ll set up how we do quality and compliance for multi-category: risk assessment, product specifications (including clear sensory and acceptance criteria), testing and transit-testing requirements, and the structure of our quality and compliance platform.
* **Supplier Onboarding & Auditing:** Get involved early in the NPD process, working with Range and Procurement to assess the risk of new products and suppliers. Lead technical onboarding, from document reviews to on-site audits (to BRCGS standard) for higher-risk own-brand suppliers, such as ready-to-eat and allergen-sensitive products.
* **Technical Due Diligence:** Own the collection, review and auditing of technical, safety and regulatory documentation across all categories (food, drink, candles, toys and other gifting items), making sure our supplier & product information collation and due diligence is watertight.
* **Labelling & Regulatory Sign-off:** Own pre-launch sign-off of own-brand labels and customer-facing product information, including ingredients, allergens, CE/UKCA marks and category-specific warnings. Put controls in place so this stays accurate across every channel when a recipe or ingredient changes.
* **Issue & Incident Management:** Lead our response to quality incidents. Drive root-cause investigations with suppliers and/or fulfilment site leads, recommend balanced, practical solutions to senior stakeholders, and hold suppliers and warehouses to account on corrective actions. Lead engagement with regulators where needed.
* **Traceability & Recall Readiness:** Own our traceability and recall/withdrawal processes as a standing capability, including running regular mock recalls to test and improve them.
* **Surveillance Testing & Performance:** Introduce surveillance testing across our own-brand range so we catch issues before our customers do. Set and own quality KPIs for our supplier base and lead the quality elements of supplier reviews. Including monitoring and taking action related to customer complaints & quality metrics.
* **Own Site Quality Processes & Frameworks:** Take overall responsibility for the quality and compliance processes and frameworks at our sites for non-horticultural products. You’ll set the standards our warehouse teams work to, from intake checks and non-conformance handling to documentation and record-keeping, keep them up to date as our range evolves, and review site records to make sure they’re consistently applied. You’ll partner closely with our on-site fulfilment leaders and quality team, who carry out the day-to-day checks.
* **Regulatory Monitoring:** Keep on top of changes in food and product safety law and turn them into practical updates to our standards, both internally and with suppliers.

### ✅ You’ll love this role if you...

* **Have a strong food safety and technical background (5+ Years of Experience)** - You’ve worked in a food technical or quality role (retailer, brand or manufacturer side) and have solid grounding in HACCP, allergen management, specifications, risk assessment and UK food law. Food safety qualifications (e.g. HACCP or Food Safety Level 4, BRCGS auditor training) are a plus.
* **Are a confident supplier auditor and manager** - You’ve carried out on-site supplier audits and know how to hold suppliers to a clear standard, firmly and constructively. You’re willing and able to have regular supplier visits
* **Are a builder and a credible generalist** - You’ve built quality processes and frameworks, not just run them, and you’re comfortable applying quality and risk fundamentals beyond food (e.g. candles, toys, non-food gifts), bringing in specialist input where needed. You know how to prioritise your work effectively.
* **Can translate the technical into the practical** - You can turn complex technical information into clear, commercially grounded recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* **You care about the detail** - you’re methodical and precise and deliver to a consistently high standard
* **Proactive - you take responsibility and initiative to get things done,** are willing to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in
* **You’re excited about problem-solving** and love to take a logical and collaborative approach to finding solutions
* **You love to collaborate,** and are at your best when working cross functionally with other teams.  You’re happy to be primarily based at our Nuneaton fulfilment site.

These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.

🏡 **Belonging @ Bloom & Wild**

We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.

🧭 **Our ways of working**

We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter.

We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team.  How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager.

Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day.

We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day:

**🌟 Work that works for you**

To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day.

For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers

**🫱‍🫲 Getting hired**

We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you.

Following this you will have a first interview with Helen (Head of Procurement & hiring manager) to go more in-depth in your experience and skillset. If successful, we would kindly ask you to complete a task (interview) with some of the team, and finally a chat with Devin, our COO.

Привіт! На зв'язку Boosters ⛹🏼
Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах EdTech, Productivity та Wellness, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.
Приклад того, як ми працюємо — наш флагманський продукт JustDone запустився за 50 днів, за 2 роки перетнув позначку в 3 млн преміум-юзерів, працює з власними AI engines та за останній рік підняв рітеншен 30-го дня на 30%.
Зараз ми шукаємо Product Analyst, який стане першим аналітиком нового R&D-продукту - AI-платформи для створення та редагування аудіовізуального контенту. Це можливість приєднатися до команди на етапі активного розвитку продукту, побудувати аналітику з нуля та допомагати команді швидко перевіряти ідеї й знаходити точки зростання на основі даних.
Твоє майбутнє середовище
Ти станеш першим аналітиком у нашому новому R&D-продукті та матимеш можливість з нуля розвивати аналітичний напрям, досліджувати поведінку користувачів, знаходити точки зростання й допомагати команді ухвалювати рішення на основі даних. Ти тісно взаємодіятимеш із Владом, Сашею та Олексієм. Лідер напрямку — Олександр, General Manager, будує команду на принципах рівності та відкритості. Він цінує самостійність, допитливість та швидкість у реалізації ініціатив. У нас не чекають вказівок, а самостійно шукають вихід із ситуацій та мають повну автономію у прийнятті рішень. А також Олександр вважає сильну культуру в команді фундаментом, тому ми інвестуємо у якісні неформальні зустрічі та спільні активності.
Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш
Можливість побудувати аналітику з нуля. Ти визначатимеш, як має працювати аналітичний напрям продукту, і впливатимеш на його розвиток від перших рішень.
Вплив на продуктові рішення. Твої дослідження та висновки допомагатимуть команді визначати пріоритети, перевіряти ідеї й знаходити нові можливості для зростання.
Роботу на перетині продукту й AI. Досліджуватимеш, як люди взаємодіють з AI-функціями, що допомагає їм отримувати цінність від продукту та які можливості варто розвивати далі.
Високу автономію та ownership. Самостійно визначатимеш пріоритети й підходи до роботи, матимеш простір для власних рішень і підтримку команди у їх реалізації.
Твоя зона впливу
Побудова та розвиток системи продуктової аналітики: від налаштування й аудиту трекінгу подій до забезпечення якості даних.
Побудова та вдосконалення LTV-моделі, прогнозування ключових бізнес-показників.
Аналіз продуктових метрик, пошук їхніх драйверів і можливостей для зростання продукту.
Дослідження поведінки користувачів, виявлення патернів і формування гіпотез для покращення продукту.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

* Work in a collaborative, intellectually stimulating environment alongside experts in the field.
* Benefit from ongoing professional development and training opportunities.

* Demonstrate creative problem-solving skills and can communicate complex concepts effectively

Please submit the following materials through the link below:

* Cover letter
* CV
* Transcript(s) (unofficial copies accepted)

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world.
