We are the UK's aviation and aerospace regulator and recognised as a world leader in its field. Our activities are diverse, enabling the aviation industry to meet the highest safety standards, and we pride ourselves on our ability to adapt to the constantly evolving aviation environment.

**The Role**

As a Software and/or Certification Airborne Electronic Hardware (AEH) and/or Development Assurance (DA) Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the overall business plan and supporting the wider CAA, specifically in establishing and delivering the UK’s ICAO State of Design responsibilities. Reporting to the Design & Certification Principal Specialist for Avionics, Electrical Systems & Development Assurance, you will be accountable for the technical investigation/analysis and approval of certification projects and the continued airworthiness of aircraft, systems, engines and propellers, across all civil aerospace domains including commercial air transport, general aviation, certified unmanned air vehicles and innovation projects.

This is a varied role that will include significant interaction with industry representatives both remotely and in person. It will also involve the review and approval of new parts and products and their design changes, validation of other nations’ certifying authorities’ work as well as the investigation of the UK Design Organisations’ design approvals. Industry and regulatory engagement will be required to ensure that the CAA keeps appraised of future projects, the proposed introduction and development of new and innovative technologies and any proposed regulatory changes

**Core Accountabilities**

1. Personal Accountabilities

* Promote a safety and learning culture that is risk based but also satisfies our basic statutory and international needs including compliance.
* Act in accordance with the CAA’s HR policies, applying our values and behaviours policies in their day-to-day role.
* Actively contribute to Personal Development Conversations, including future personal development and progression opportunities.
* Create time to learn and develop.
* Ensure that all recommendations and decisions are proportionate to the needs and safety expectations of the sector and are consistent with extant regulatory policy (using objective risk assessment techniques as necessary)

2. Design and Certification Accountabilities

Evaluate certification projects, as directed by the Principal Design and Certification Specialist, in relation to aerospace products.

These may include submissions from both UK Design Organisations and those provided for validation under bilateral arrangements.

* Determine compliance with airworthiness requirements and making recommendations for approval of product or change through sampling of submitted applicant data in accordance with Level of Involvement principles.
* Support applications for Flight Conditions, using your specialist knowledge and skills to make a recommendation whether an air or rotorcraft meets the intent of ‘safe flight and landing’ in lieu of full or partial certification compliance.
* Ensure that aerospace products, for which the CAA has responsibility, meet applicable initial and continued airworthiness standards and ensure in-service issues are adequately addressed to maintain the intended level of safety. Additionally, play a leading role in the development of associated airworthiness requirements.
* Clarify, where necessary, existing airworthiness requirements and contribute to the development of new requirements to cover new technology, novel applications of existing technology, and novel proposals for compliance demonstration (this could be through authoring Certification Review Items, as appropriate).
* Enact type design liaison responsibilities on aerospace products and make recommendations as appropriate to colleagues inside and outside CAA (including other Regulatory Agencies) to ensure continued airworthiness and safety standards are met.
* When required, act as Project Certification Manager (PCM) to coordinate projects or ‘specialists’ in specific technical disciplines.
* Identify and coordinate research or contribute into areas of significant airworthiness concern. Represent the CAA and / or Airworthiness in decision making committees and working groups, internally and externally, nationally and internationally from a design standpoint.
* Liaise with other regulators and accident investigation bodies in relation to accidents and events and their ICAO Annex 13 investigations or equivalent.

**About You:**Ideally, you will be able to demonstrate industry experience with an equivalent qualification, be a proven expert with detailed knowledge of the functioning and management of the aerospace industry, and have proven aerospace experience, preferably working for an approved aerospace organisation.

**Essential Criteria:** Proven knowledge of certification of highly complex systems and their development and integration, Software and/or Airborne Electronic Hardware (AEH) and/or Aircraft System Certification, with experience in performing Stage of Involvement Audits (SOI) and/or System Reviews (SRs) with regulatory bodies. This could have been gained from working within Industry as an expert and/or gained through relevant experience within an Airworthiness Authority. We anticipate you will have demonstrable knowledge and experience in **one or more** of the following technical areas:

1. Software up to IDAL A

* Knowledge of IMA design and architecture
* Familiarity with avionics communications protocols including ARINC, AFDX and serial interfaces.
* Familiarity with single core and multi-core certification requirements
* Experienced with software and hardware integration and formal verification methods
* Well versed in procedural and Object orientated programming languages.
* Hands-on experience (preferably leading) SOI audits.

2. Airborne Electronic Hardware (AEH) up to IDAL A

* Experience in applying and following the guidance of ED-80/DO-254 at various Item Design Assurance Levels (IDALs).
* Hands-on experience of Hardware Architectures and design processes related to hardware RAM/Flash Based FPGAs, ASICs, COTS processor/devices, PDH.
* Familiarity with avionics communications protocols including ARINC, AFDX and serial interfaces.
* Hands-on experience (preferably leading) SOI audits.
* Experience in verification methods, RTL, Post-Layout, Hardware integration. Experience with Advanced Verification Methods is a plus.
* A process-oriented mindset, but with the capability to assess technically complex hardware and certification aspects for AEH

2. Development Assurance (DA) up to FDAL A

* Experience in defining the scope of and leading System Reviews per ARP4754A/B for various Functional Development Assurance Levels (FDALs)
* Familiarisation with various safety analysis techniques per ARP4761 and how they are applied to derive safety objectives.
* The ability to review and analyse aircraft, system, sub-system and item architectures with respect to safety objectives (including a good understanding of the decomposition of Functional to Item Development Assurance Levels).
* An understanding of system life‐cycle processes.
* Confidence in critiquing proposed requirements analysis, decomposition and traceability.
* Experience in managing interfaces and ensure cross‐discipline consistency – decomposition through indenture levels from aircraft to items.

You will also be:

* Able to operate in various cultural business environments at all levels.
* Capable of using experience and making sound judgments.
* Able to think laterally to identify any wider implications.
* Able to effectively manage your own workload with a wide variety of projects with differing priorities.
* Able to understand specialist issues and modulate technical views to account for wider business and political considerations.
* Able to challenge information, propositions or assumptions, often of a deep technical nature and across a range of disciplines, affecting safety.
* Capable of making timely, reasoned decisions.
* Able to decide when enough information is available to make a decision affecting safety.
* Able to identify when to escalate issues to their Line Manager and others as appropriate.
* Confident communicator at all levels, having the ability to conduct technical conversation and engage with all stakeholders.
* Able to perform report writing and co-ordination of reports in support of your day-to-day role.
* Capable of using multiple IT systems and infrastructure in order to fulfil the objectives of your day-to-day role.
* Able to act in a professional and collaborative manner with both internal and external stakeholders.

**Desirable Criteria:**

* The desire to continually develop experience through project involvement and dedicated training.
* Experience in design/development assurance of Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).

# **Payment Operations Engineer**

Customer-Facing · Remote, Europe, Africa or Asia

### **About Caliza**

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

### **Our backers**

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

## **About the role**

Caliza moves money across fiat payment rails in the Americas, Europe and Asia, including Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA and CNAPS, as well as blockchains. Most payments flow through automatically. When one doesn't, our customers need someone who can work out exactly what happened, explain it clearly, and get it resolved.

That's this role. When a customer asks "where's my payment?", you'll own the answer. You'll follow the payment from their API call, through our internal systems and ledger, out to our partner banks, the payment rail or the blockchain, and back. Then you'll explain what you found to the customer, push the bank for answers when needed, and hand our engineers a precise problem when something is genuinely broken.

You don't need to be an expert in every system a payment touches, but you need to be able to follow one through all of them. You're comfortable reading logs, querying a database and decoding a bank message, and equally comfortable explaining what you found to a customer, a bank or an engineer. You'll build a deep understanding of how our rails really behave over time; we'll teach you the Caliza-specific parts.

**Location:** Europe, Africa, or Asia. You'll be based there so customers get help during their working hours, but the role covers every rail we operate, not just the ones in your region. Professional English required.

## **In your first six months, you'll**

* Learn how payments flow through Caliza end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoins.
* Within three months, understand all of our rails well enough to handle most customer payment issues on your own, whichever rail they're on.
* Own customer payment investigations during your hours, across every rail, keeping customers informed from first message to resolution.
* Write runbooks for the issues you see most, so the rest of the team can rely on them.
* Build at least one tool or automation that measurably reduces manual work.

## **What you'll be doing**

* Be the technical point of contact for customers with payment problems, especially when the answer isn't obvious.
* Answer technical API questions from live customers, such as failed webhooks, error codes or unexpected payment statuses. Helping new customers integrate before launch is handled separately by engineering.
* Trace payments across our API, internal systems, ledger, partner banks, rails and blockchain to find where things stand and what happens next.
* Tell expected behavior from a real bug, and escalate to engineering with clear evidence when it's a bug.
* Work with partner banks and providers on investigations, returns and recalls.
* Support compliance with information requests about specific payments.
* Tag the root cause of each issue so we can fix the most common ones for good.
* Review new rails and corridors before launch, bringing an operational view of how they'll fail.
* Write SQL queries and scripts to automate repetitive work.

## **What we're looking for**

* 3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a fintech, payments company, bank or API-first business, such as technical support, payment operations or implementation.
* A solid understanding of how payments work: statuses, settlement, cutoffs, finality, returns and recalls. Experience with any major rail is fine; we'll teach you ours.
* Comfort reading JSON API requests, logs and webhooks.
* Working SQL, and some scripting in Python or similar.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, for scripting, investigation or documentation, with the judgment to check what they produce.
* A methodical approach to investigations: you form hypotheses and check them, rather than guessing.
* Clear, calm communication with customers, especially when the full answer isn't known yet.
* Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

## **Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with any of our rails: Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst) or CNAPS. Experience across more than one region is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.053, camt.056).
* Experience with stablecoins, crypto wallets or block explorers.
* Experience working with partner or sponsor banks on investigations.

**Job Title: Senior Manager, Account Executive Operations**

  

**Location: Hammersmith, London - Hybrid**

  

**Working Pattern: 2 days in-office and 3 days remote.**

  

**Our Mission**

  

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best WorkplacesTM list. **Hear from our team** about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

  

**About the Role**

  

The Senior Manager, Account Executive Operations for Technical Quality of Acceptance, leads the UK-based operational delivery and project management of our acceptance strategy across international markets. Directing high-performing, globally dispersed teams, the role drives key technical initiatives, including Acceptance Referrals and establishing a new international ATM workstream, to expand ecosystem performance. The role safeguards cardholder transaction reliability across the end-to-end payment chain (POS, e-commerce, ATM, gateways, PSPs, and acquirers) by utilizing operational insights to detect emerging risks and drive swift remediation. Partnering across Strategy, Product, Technology, Networks, Commercial, and Data, this position aligns international priorities and executes complex projects to resolve acceptance issues at local, market, and Network levels.

  

**What you’ll do**

  

* Lead, mentor and develop high-performing teams of operational professionals, including managers and specialists across country acceptance, analytics, and referral investigation. Set clear goals, manage performance and capacity, and build technical and operational capability.
* Lead the project delivery of the Technical Quality of Acceptance strategy, translating global priorities into practical, market-specific plans across targeted global territories.
* Coordinate specialist resources and apply disciplined problem-management practices, including root-cause analysis, remediation ownership, progress tracking, recovery validation and lessons learned.
* Lead complex, cross-functional regional initiatives that strengthen technical acceptance resilience, improve monitoring and detection, remove recurring failure modes, and support technical acceptance stability. Apply disciplined project-management practices to define scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance, senior stakeholder communications and delivery plans.
* Build strong internal partnerships across Networks, Operations, Sales, Market Development, and Strategy Teams; influence decisions and drive alignment across differing priorities.
* Establish and maintain clear KPIs, reporting, playbooks, escalation paths, operating controls and documentation for technical acceptance monitoring, investigation and remediation.
* Represent the Technical Quality of Acceptance function in governance forums, launch-readiness reviews, roadmap discussions and executive updates, clearly communicating risk, dependencies, decisions and regional impact.
* Develop team and stakeholder capability through training and knowledge sharing on payment flows, acceptance failure modes, investigation methods, escalation and remediation practices.
* Engage externally when necessary to clarify technical issues, coordinate remediation or support strategic acceptance priorities; external client interaction is limited and purposeful, with approximately 15% travel.

  

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Experience in technical acceptance, acquiring, merchant processing, payment operations, network operations, payment technology or related fields.
* Solid People Leadership experience; including managing managers
* Experience working for a global payment network, acquirer, merchant-services provider, processor, PSP, gateway, payment-orchestration platform, merchant or ATM operator, with substantial technical acceptance exposure.
* Experience leading regional or global programmes involving acquirers, processors, PSPs, merchants, payment platforms or other acceptance ecosystem participants.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, actionable insights.
* Collaborative, solution-oriented mindset with solid teamwork skills; proven ability to drive results by working across functions
* Strong organizational skills, and focus on achieving both short and long term goals
* Proven ability to leverage data to define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure and demonstrate individual and team performance.

  

**Where and how you'll work**

This is a permanent position based in our **Hammersmith, London office**.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend two days a week in the office.

  

**What’s in it for you**

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

  

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  

**Wealth & Future:** Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

**Holidays:** Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.

**Health:** Access premium care through our private medical insurance.

**Family Support:** We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

  

A full list of our benefits is available**here**.

  

**What you should know about how we recruit**

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

  

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

  

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

(COPSSC).

  
****Who We Are****  
  
At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.  
  
Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

**About the Role**

  

Capital One is searching for an Incident and Problem Manager to join our UK Technology Operations Centre (TOC) team. The TOC is dedicated to the effective management, coordination, and communication of all major and critical incidents, as well as owning post-incident Root Cause Analysis.

  

This role is highly service-focused and requires close liaison with internal Technology teams, Business Partners, and real-time engagement with sourcing partners and suppliers to effectively manage major and critical Incidents and Problems impacting our business. 

  

Initiatives such as Reliability Testing Game Days utilising Chaos experiments to maintain always-on Incident readiness across UK Tech in our operational and technical response will be a prominent feature of this role so relevant experience in these areas is preferable.

  

The successful candidate must have strong Incident Management experience, a Technology background and experience in utilising AI to remove TOIL and add value. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to display a flexible problem solving approach are essential.

  

***The TOC is a 24\*7\*365 operation with online presence between 08:00-17:30 and on-call coverage providing out of hours support.***

  

**What you’ll do**

  

* **Lead Investigations:** You will direct investigations into major and critical incidents by managing, coordinating, and appropriately challenging technical resources on a 24\*7\*365 basis.
* **Drive Communications:** Ensure that incident progress is continuously tracked via action plans and communicated effectively to the wider organisation.
* **Coordinate Teams for Quick Resolution:** Lead virtual and office-based support teams to ensure the restoration of normal service operations as rapidly as possible, keeping business disruption to a minimum.
* **Rigorous Root Cause Analysis:** Conduct investigations into root cause utilising 5 why’s methodology, while establishing actions to prevent recurrence and raise standards across Tech.
* **Drive Incident Readiness:** Greater service stability means fewer opportunities to prove tech resiliency and sharpen critical Incident behaviours. You’ll play a key role ensuring our people and Tech are always ready via Game Days in support of our Reliability Assurance agenda.
* **Spearhead Process Improvement:** Lead process and service improvement initiatives that align with your personal development objectives. This is your chance to embrace AI, as well as automate repetitive, manual incident and problem management tasks.
* **Provide On-Call Support:** You will perform on-call cover for Incident Management on rotation.

  

**What we’re looking for**

 

* An inquisitive and proactive mindset.
* Ability to communicate openly and effectively in both written and verbal form, with the confidence to meet effectively with external and internal Senior stakeholders.
* The ability to remain calm and focused in a pressured environment, carefully considering the needs of multiple stakeholders.

* An understanding of AWS Cloud technology principles. (Note: If you have advanced technical skills here, you will be highly empowered to drive automation!)

* Highly organised with an ability to remain focused and flexible when managing multiple initiatives
* Prior experience of using AI to drive process improvement initiatives that have added tangible value

**Where and how you'll work**

The coordinator must ensure that supply chain processes are robust, compliant, and optimised for high-value, low-volume to high-rate transition in a technical engineering environment.

 ● Supplier Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for routine supplier correspondence, confirming order details and managing day-to-day queries via professional email, telephone, and approved WhatsApp channels where required for rapid response.

# SOCIAL WORK ASSISTANT - Cardiff Fostering Service

## About The Service

Becoming a Social Work Assistant offers a great opportunity to become involved in making a real difference to the lives of children, young people and families in Cardiff.

Cardiff Children's Services offer a range of opportunities for career development, including funded secondments to various degree and post graduate training courses.

Cardiff offers the opportunity to grow and develop through high quality training, regular and effective supervision, and a wide variety of opportunities to pursue career development, for example we have funded Social Work Assistants to go to university to obtain their Social Work qualification.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the service which puts the individual at the heart of our work. The teams work from a strengths-based approach to meet the needs of young people and their families.

Cardiff is one of the fastest growing cities in Britain and is the first city in the UK to be declared as a UNICEF Child Friendly City that places the rights of children and young people at the head of our policies and strategies.

Parents have the most significant influence on children and on their future lives. It is our belief that outcomes for children are best when they are supported to grow and achieve within their own families. This belief has driven the 'Think Family' approach which looks at the family as a whole and co-ordinates support across the public services, tailored to each family's needs and strengths.

If you are interested in being part of Cardiff's journey to becoming one of the most vibrant and successful cities within the UK that puts Children first with the ambition of being a lead force behind practice development in Wales we would be excited to hear from you.

## About the job

**Benefits offered**

Cardiff is frequently found at the top of lists of best cities in the UK to live in so come join us and see what we can offer.

* A generous annual leave entitlement starting at 28 days per year to a maximum of 33 days per year after 5 years, with the option to purchase additional annual leave to a maximum of 10 days.
* Our working culture is flexible
* Hybrid working - supporting you to flexibly deliver your role whether on visits, from an office or your home.
* Access to the, which is part of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS), offering a reputable, secure and flexible pension plan for peace of mind.

We are looking for Social work Assistants to work within Cardiff Children's Fostering Service.

The successful candidate will join our established and supportive team who, with the support of the Principal Social Worker (PSW) and will assist with the delivery of services. The successful candidate will be responsible for case allocation of a caseload of foster carers to provide support and supervision to foster carers.

There may be occasions when you will be required to attend events to support foster carer recruitment and promotional campaigns.

## Synthetic Chemist

**Analysis review scientist – NMR & UPLC-MS interpretation**

**About Chemify**

Chemify is creating a future where important molecules, drugs and currently unimaginable new materials are instantly accessible; thereby radically increasing the speed of innovation, quality of life, and reach of humanity. The company is building the infrastructure to digitize chemistry for the design, discovery and synthesis of new molecules with the desired function and properties instantly and on-demand. Chemify has built a platform that combines purpose-built programming languages, robotics, AI, and the world's largest and continuously growing database of chemical programs to accelerate chemical discovery to new, transformative heights.

Chemify is supported by some of the best investors from Silicon Valley and across the world, including Triatomic Capital, BlueYard Ventures, DCVC, Founders Fund, and others.

**What we offer**

You'll join our analysis review team interpreting 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data generated by our automated synthesis platform, playing a direct and critical role in keeping our chemistry pipeline moving. You'll also get exposure to a wide variety of organic chemistry reactions passing through the platform — genuinely interesting territory if you enjoy the puzzle of structure elucidation. This is an entry point into the synthetic chemistry industry, with full training provided. Working a shift pattern that includes evenings and weekends, you'll also earn a competitive uplift for unsocial hours on top of your base salary.

**Job purpose**

As our Analysis Review Scientist, you will review and interpret 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data produced by our automated chemistry platform, confirming that reactions and purifications have produced the expected outcome, flagging anomalies for further investigation, and generating high-quality reports. This is a computer-based role, working with digital spectra and data files rather than at the bench. The role follows a structured, repeatable process across a high volume of samples each shift, and forms part of a rota that includes evenings and weekends to keep pace with round-the-clock synthesis.

**Who we are looking for**

We're looking for an entry-level scientist — ideal for a recent chemistry graduate or someone early in their career — who is comfortable with focused, detail-oriented work performed to a consistent standard. You'll have a working knowledge of 1H-NMR and mass spectrometry from your studies or lab experience, a methodical approach to spotting when something doesn't match expectations, and the flexibility to work a rota that includes evenings and weekends. Strong communication matters too: you'll work closely with our synthesis program manager team on interpreting outcomes, and may occasionally liaise with the operations team when troubleshooting instrument or pipeline issues.

**Key responsibilities**

• Data interpretation: Review 1H-NMR spectra and UPLC-MS traces against expected reaction and purification outcomes, confirming success or diagnosing likely products and where a reaction may have gone wrong, to help inform future runs.

• Volume and turnaround: Process a high throughput of samples each shift to keep pace with the automated synthesis platform, maintaining consistent accuracy and speed.

• Shift coverage: Work a rota that includes evenings and weekends, providing near-continuous data turnaround for the chemistry team.

• Escalation: Flag ambiguous or unexpected spectra to senior scientists for further review, and report issues with the software platform or automated processing and verification steps.

• Record keeping: Maintain accurate, consistent records of interpretations and decisions in line with SOPs.

• Quality and compliance: Follow SOPs and quality procedures for data review and support timely investigation of flagged discrepancies or audit findings.

• Continuous improvement: Feedback patterns or recurring issues you spot to help refine interpretation guidelines over time, collaborating cross-functionally in line with one of Chemify's core values.

**Location:** Remote (all UK locations considered) with flexible working arrangements. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Bristol and Exeter.

**ABOUT US**

City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.

Our software and product development team produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like Cadence and our decarbonisation tool, to successfully deliver our projects.

We work collaboratively across our consultancy team made up of transport, energy, sustainability, carbon accounting and applied data science specialists to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes forward-thinking local authorities like Oxfordshire County Council, sub-national transport bodies like England’s Economic Heartland and national organisations like Department of Energy Security & Net Zero (see our full list of projects here).

We have a series of emerging services lines (which are all underpinned by market areas), including the following focused within:

·        **Net Zero Strategies & Roadmaps** (e.g. Area-based future decarbonisation pathways, green growth strategies)

·        **Net Zero Development** (e.g. Transport evidence bases for Local Plans and infrastructure strategies)

·        **Sustainable Transport** (e.g. Local cycle & walking infrastructure plans (LCWIPs), bus service planning and movement strategies)

·        **Net Zero Transport** (e.g. Electric Vehicle charging strategies and net zero transport pathways)

·        **Transport Modelling** (e.g. Strategic, freight, micro-simulation and active travel modelling)

·        **Heat & Retrofit** (e.g. Heat pumps sizing, internet of things)

·        **Energy Planning** (e.g. Local Areas Energy Plans)

·        **Energy Modelling** (e.g. DNO capacity, building monitoring/benchmarking)

·        **Data Engineering** (e.g. Future technology roadmaps)

·        **Carbon Accounting** (e.g. Business decarbonisation, circular economy)

**About the Role**

We are looking to grow our team of developers working across the full stack to deliver cutting edge applications and tools to support our decarbonisation mission. This role requires highly talented individuals who can take a proactive role in problem solving. Successful candidates must be able to show extremely high aptitude in mathematics and analytical problem solving.

Existing coding skills are not required but are desirable and driven candidates with self-taught skills are particularly encouraged to apply. City Science predominantly uses JavaScript and Python, but other languages are also used, and all experience is considered. Experience working with cloud-based services is also desirable. Experience using AI to support software development is welcome but we expect candidates to demonstrate and develop independent skills, motivation and communication throughout the application process.

·        Develop and maintain a range of applications and tools that support clients to plan, monitor, evidence and visualise their decarbonisation pathway

·        Energy Modelling (e.g. Home Energy Model, building physics/benchmarking)

·        Support staff internally to provide insights with a high level of automation/digitisation, meeting or exceeding industry standard practices

·        Manage the full development stack and work flexibly to meet emerging need

·        Collaborate across teams and grow relationships between consultancy professionals and software developers

·        Drive new technologies and integrated ways of working

·        Communicate the case for decarbonisation through cutting edge software tools

·        Drive to learn and develop coding and technology skills across the full stack (experience and/or self-taught skills desirable)

·        Excellent problem solver

·        Can demonstrate ability to work as part of a team, collaborating effectively with both internal and external stakeholders

·        Proven science communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences

·        Passion to make the case for, and execute, decarbonisation

·        Opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across the consultancy business

·        Opportunity for career progression

·        25 days annual leave entitlement

·        Competitive salary (based on skills and experience)

·        Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership)

·        Flexible working arrangements

·        Membership of our group pension scheme

**FURTHER INFORMATION**

We are building a team who are motivated by collaboration with the desire to solve problems for our customers. Prisoners working towards a qualification in this area will be assessed by Specialist Production Instructors. However, the job holder may be required to input supportive statements into assessments.   
   
Although this is a non-operational job in an establishment with no line management responsibilities, the job holder will have workshop and prisoner management responsibilities.

The job holder will be able to brief prisoners within the Waste Management Unit on what is required of them. # Title:  DevOps Team Lead

Location: 

United Kingdom, Whiteley, Hampshire, GB

**Who we are**

DTC, a Codan Company, is a leading provider of advanced communications technology supporting defence, security, broadcast, public safety, and mission-critical operations worldwide.

As part of Codan Limited, an international technology company with a long-standing reputation for delivering trusted communications solutions, DTC combines specialist engineering expertise with global resources to develop products that perform in some of the world’s most demanding operational environments.

Our technology enables the secure and reliable transmission of video, voice, and data. We work closely with customers and industry partners to address evolving operational challenges while meeting rigorous performance, quality, security, and regulatory standards.

Joining DTC offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals on advanced wireless communication technologies with a meaningful real-world impact. Employees benefit from the strength of a global organisation while contributing within a focused, agile, and collaborative engineering environment.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a DevOps Team Lead with strong software testing experience to join our Engineering team in Whiteley, Hampshire.

This is a new, hands-on role offering the opportunity to establish and develop DTC’s DevOps team, initially leading two engineers, with potential scope for further growth as business needs develop.

Reporting to the Engineering Director, you will own the development infrastructure, source control workflows and CI/CD pipelines that support our software and embedded communications products. Alongside this, you will lead software test planning and automation, helping ensure that changes deliver the intended functionality and that existing features continue to perform reliably.

Working closely with software, systems and test engineers, you will help turn engineering requirements into repeatable tests, reliable builds and controlled releases. We welcome candidates from a range of software backgrounds. Experience with embedded systems or FPGA development would be beneficial, but is not essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish, lead and mentor a DevOps team, combining hands-on technical delivery with the development of team capability and effective working practices.
* Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automating builds, testing and deployment to appropriate test environments.
* Maintain reliable, repeatable build environments, including dependencies, engineer access and investigation of build or pipeline failures.
* Develop automated nightly build and test processes, making results accessible and helping engineers identify and resolve issues.
* Work with engineering teams from the start of projects to translate requirements into test plans, test cases and automated tests.
* Lead functional, integration, system and regression testing to verify software behaviour and assess the impact of changes.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices linking engineering requirements to test coverage and results.
* Manage Git workflows across multiple development and release branches, coordinating merges and ensuring fixes reach the appropriate releases.
* Build and tag releases, maintain release artefacts and ensure build and test results are traceable to the relevant source and configuration.
* Provide clear visibility of test progress, defects, technical risks and release readiness.
* Continuously improve development workflows, test automation, infrastructure and release processes.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong hands-on DevOps experience, including ownership of CI/CD pipelines, build automation and development infrastructure.
* Strong software testing experience, with a practical understanding of functional, integration, system and regression testing.
* Strong practical Git experience, including managing multiple active branches, merging changes, carrying fixes between releases and resolving conflicts.
* Experience using Jenkins or a comparable CI/CD platform to automate build and test workflows.
* Experience translating software or engineering requirements into test plans, test cases and traceable test evidence.
* Practical experience developing and maintaining automated tests, scripts or test frameworks.
* Experience supporting software releases and investigating build failures, test failures and software defects.
* The ability to lead and coordinate a technical team while remaining actively involved in delivery.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical risks, test results and release readiness to different audiences.
* Eligibility to obtain UK Security Check clearance.

**Desirable Skills**

* Familiarity with SVN source control.
* Experience with embedded software, FPGA development, electronics or hardware-integrated products.
* Experience with software-defined radios, wireless communications or networking technologies.
* Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, C, C++ or MATLAB.
* Knowledge of hardware-in-the-loop, device-level or RF testing.
* Experience establishing a new team or improving existing DevOps and software testing practices.
* Experience within defence, public safety, broadcast, or another highly regulated or mission-critical environment.

**Why join DTC**

* Work on advanced wireless communication technology used in demanding environments around the world.
* Shape a new DevOps team and take ownership of the processes that support reliable software builds, testing and releases.
* Collaborate with experienced specialists across a range of engineering disciplines.
* Contribute to products that support defence, public safety, broadcast, and mission-critical operations.
* Benefit from flexible working, a strong benefits package, and ongoing professional development.
* Join a focused and agile engineering business backed by the resources and international reach of the Codan Group.

**Apply**

If you enjoy hands-on DevOps, have strong software testing experience and want to shape a new team supporting technology that performs when reliable communication matters most, we would be pleased to hear from you.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Consultant to join our Dynamics 365 & Power Platform practice. You will play a key role in designing, extending, and delivering modern business applications built on Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365 (CE/CRM), Model-Driven Apps, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Azure integration services.

You’ll work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, developers, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping shape solution direction and drive platform adoption.

## Key Responsibilities

**Solution Delivery**

* Design, configure, and extend Dynamics 365 CE / Power Platform solutions across Customer Service, Sales, Case/Workflow Management, and custom line-of-business scenarios.
* Build and enhance Model-Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, Power Automate flows, Power Pages, and PCF controls where required.
* Implement Dataverse data models, business rules, security roles, environment strategies, and ALM processes.
* Work with developers to deliver plug-ins, Azure Functions, logic apps, APIs, and integrations following best practices.

**Client Partnership & Consulting**

* Work directly with business and technical stakeholders to shape requirements and solution approach.
* Maintain a trusted-advisor relationship, ensuring customers understand platform capabilities and roadmap.
* Support pre-sales activities including solution design input, demonstrations, and proposal responses.

**Delivery Leadership**

* Support project planning, estimation, sprint planning, and quality assurance.
* Mentor consultants and developers in solution design, configuration, and technical standards.
* Identify delivery risks and help define mitigation strategies.

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

**Required:**

* 5+ years implementing Dynamics 365 CE / Power Platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on configuration experience with:
* Model-Driven Apps & Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Security / Environment / Solution Management
* Experience designing or integrating Azure cloud services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management).
* Solid understanding of C# & .NET, Dataverse plugin development, JavaScript form customisation, and REST APIs.
* Experience working in Agile / sprint-based delivery.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Advantageous (nice-to-have, not required):**

* Copilot Studio / AI Builder / Intelligent Automation
* Power Pages design and governance
* Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) experience
* Power BI data modelling / dashboards
* Experience in regulated or public-sector delivery environments
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD for Power Platform solutions (Pipelines / Git Repos)
* Understanding of Microsoft Fabric / Synapse / Data Lake architectures

**What You Bring**

You combine technical depth with strong consulting and communication skills. You’re comfortable translating business needs into clear solution designs and you can guide customers through platform possibilities and constraints. You’re collaborative, hands-on, and motivated to deliver solutions that work and last.

## About Codec

Established over 40 years ago, Codec is a multi-award-winning Microsoft Solutions Partner, trusted by public and private sector organisations to deliver impactful digital transformation. With offices in **Dublin**, **Belfast**, **Cologne**, and across **Germany**, our team of over **300 experts** specialises in harnessing the full potential of Microsoft technologies—including **Dynamics 365**, **Power Platform**, **Azure**, and **Copilot**—to drive innovation, automation, and operational excellence. - Implement resilient bidirectional messaging pipelines to dispatch remote control commands, configuration updates, and firmware state synchronisations over cellular and IoT networks.

**2. Application development & iterative feature engineering**

- Build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring using strong Laravel/PHP skills.

- Use MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity where appropriate.

- Implement responsive operator interfaces and control panels within the ARC platform and DTCommand, translating UI/UX wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design specs provided by the Lead Digital Product Designer into functional frontend components and backend APIs

- Drive the phased, iterative evolution of hardware features in close alignment with the Head of Product and Lead Digital Product Designer - progressing device commands from simple manual toggles to rule-based timed intervals, telemetry-driven thresholds, and machine-learning assisted automations.

- Architect and scale background queue consumers to process high-frequency device heartbeats, pings, and alarm events with minimal latency.

- Build and maintain secure RESTful and event-driven APIs connecting device management services with the core ARC platform, DTCommand client portal, and mobile applications.

**3. Troubleshooting and support**

- Troubleshoot issues across the hardware/software boundary, working with engineering, repair and manufacturing colleagues as needed.

- Partner closely with hardware and embedded firmware engineers to define clear interface contracts, payload schemas, and MQTT topic structures for emerging device revisions and product features.

**4. Security, compliance and reliability**

- Apply a security-conscious approach to device connectivity, reflecting the critical, safety-related nature of alarm signalling.

- Implement strict security standards across all device communications, including transport encryption (TLS/mTLS), secure token/credential rotation, and mutual authentication.

- Ensure signalling architectures comply with alarm industry standards (such as BS EN 50131 / BS 5979 / PD 6662) and data privacy regulations (GDPR).

- Establish monitoring, synthetic health checks, and alerting on device listener sockets and broker connections to detect dropouts or network degradation proactively.

**5. Sprint delivery and platform collaboration**

- Participate actively in Agile sprint meeting with the Technical Delivery Manager, delivering predictable milestones on product engineering initiatives.

- Partner with the Lead Full Stack Developer for architectural guidance, code reviews, and API schema design to ensure IoT components integrate cleanly into the wider Laravel ecosystem.

- Collaborate closely with the Lead Digital Product Designer to review user interaction models, technical feasibility of UI components, and stateful feedback loops.

- Liaise with the MuleSoft / Integration team to ensure device information from manufacturing and repair configurations can be synchronised.

**Essential**

- Experience integrating software with IoT/hardware devices (for example alarm signalling equipment, sensors, gateways).

- Understanding of relevant signalling protocols/standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).

- Strong Laravel/PHP skills to build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring.

- Comfortable troubleshooting issues across the hardware/software boundary.

- A security-conscious approach to device connectivity, given the critical nature of alarm signalling.

- Background developing web applications, microservices, or daemons in modern PHP/Laravel (including queue workers, and event broadcasting).

- Practical experience working with MQTT, WebSockets, or publish/subscribe messaging architectures for device connectivity and telemetry ingestion.

- Demonstrated ability to translate raw hardware sensor data (telemetry, environmental inputs, battery budgets) into functional software applications and clear visual states.

- Familiarity with appropriate databases and caching/queue technologies for high-volume event processing.

- Collaborative team player, comfortable working across disciplines with embedded firmware engineers, product managers, digital designers, and manufacturing/repair technicians.

**Desirable**

- Experience with MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity.

- Experience in the security, alarm or IoT hardware industry.

- Familiarity with frontend technologies commonly used in the Laravel ecosystem

## Work directly with our CEO to fix how Doccla runs, from AI enablement to cross-team initiatives, at a virtual care company partnering with over 60% of the NHS.

**Location:** Hammersmith, London (hybrid, with at least 3 days in office)  
**Reports to:** CEO

### About Doccla

Doccla is a leading virtual care company transforming how healthcare is delivered across the UK and Europe. We partner with over 60% of the NHS and health systems in Europe to deliver proactive virtual care that improves outcomes, reduces admissions, and frees up clinical capacity.

We serve patients across the entire care continuum, enabling one partner to support patients through proactive management, remote monitoring, and virtual ward care. This allows clinicians to identify rising-risk patients early, manage deterioration proactively, and enable earlier discharge and recovery at home.

### The Role

The Founders' Associate works directly with the CEO to fix how the company runs. When information is scattered across fifteen Google Docs, you build the one place it should live. When a process falls between teams and no one owns it, you take it and sort it out. When a team is drowning in manual work, you build the tool that removes it.

It suits someone who spots the real bottleneck and goes after it, without waiting to be asked. You will report into the CEO and work closely with the CFO and senior leadership team.

### What you own

* **Internal AI enablement.** Get the whole company using AI where it actually helps. Find the tasks that eat the most time across teams, show people how to build their own fixes, and build the workflows yourself where it's faster to just do it.
* **Cross-team initiatives.** Take on the least-defined problems on the CEO's desk - scope them, build the plan, pull in the right people and see them through.
* **Company information architecture.** Sort out how information, decisions and documents move through Doccla, so handovers are clean and there's one reliable place to find things instead of fifteen. This also becomes the foundation our AI tools rely on.
* **The founder's right hand.** Support with board meetings, company all-hands, and management meetings, providing the senior leadership team with the space to make important decisions.

### Who you are

* **You are AI-native and can build.** You ship code and you ship agents. You prototype the thing instead of writing a memo about the thing.
* **You think in systems.** You see the company as inputs, bottlenecks and outputs, and you go after the bottleneck.
* **High agency, low ego.** You care about the result and take the initiative to solve a problem without being told to do it. You will do the unglamorous job if it is the one that matters.
* **You believe in the mission.** We are a group of individuals who are passionate about transforming healthcare delivery at scale. We move fast and we are kind to each other.

## The Opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious, resilient and highly commercially driven **Sales Manager** to play a key role in launching **all about automation Detroit** – the first US edition of the established European trade show series for industrial automation, robotics and digitalisation.

Taking place on **20–21 October 2027 at Vibe Credit Union Showplace in Novi, Michigan**, this is a rare opportunity to join a show at the beginning of its US journey and help build a new event and customer community from the ground up.

all about automation has established a successful format across Europe by bringing technology providers together with automation, engineering and manufacturing professionals in a compact, highly focused trade show environment. Detroit represents the next major step in the brand's international expansion and its first launch into the US market.

This is a **new-business-led sales role** for someone who thrives on the challenge and opportunity of a launch. You will be responsible for identifying and engaging prospective exhibitors, building a strong pipeline and converting new customers into the founding exhibitor community for Detroit.

You will need a genuine hunter mentality: someone comfortable creating their own opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads, who can research a market, identify decision-makers, pick up the phone, tell a compelling story and confidently close business.

Launching a new event also requires resilience, curiosity and initiative. You will be selling a proposition without the benefit of a previous US edition, so you'll need to be able to articulate why Detroit, why all about automation and why now – using the success and credibility of the established European series while adapting the proposition to the needs of the US automation and manufacturing market.

**This is a US-market-facing role, and flexibility around working hours is an essential requirement.** The successful candidate must be willing and able to regularly work hours that align with customers and prospects in the United States. This will include working approximately **11am–7pm or 12pm–8pm on two to three days per week**, with additional flexibility where required to maximise customer contact across US time zones.

The successful candidate must also be **willing and able to travel to the United States as required by the business**. This will include travel for the Detroit event itself and may include customer meetings, industry events, competitor shows, networking opportunities and other activity that supports the successful launch and growth of the event.

For someone excited by building something new, this is an opportunity to have a visible impact on the creation of a new international event and establish yourself within one of the world's most important manufacturing and automation markets.

## Key Responsibilities

### New Business Development & Prospecting

* Take ownership of building and converting a substantial new-business pipeline for the launch of all about automation Detroit.
* Identify, research and engage prospective exhibitors across the industrial automation, robotics, engineering, digitalisation and advanced manufacturing markets.
* Proactively generate your own leads through outbound calling, email, LinkedIn, market research, referrals, competitive events and industry networking.
* Map the US automation ecosystem and identify manufacturers, technology providers, systems integrators, distributors, software businesses and service providers that should be represented at the event.
* Identify relevant decision-makers and develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within target organisations.
* Maintain a consistently high level of outbound sales activity and prospect engagement.
* Manage prospects through the complete sales cycle, from initial contact and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close.
* Build urgency around participation in the inaugural Detroit edition and convert prospects into founding exhibitors.
* Consistently work towards and exceed individual revenue, exhibitor and activity targets.

### Launch Sales & Market Development

* Become an expert in the all about automation proposition and confidently communicate the rationale behind bringing the established European format to the US.
* Develop a compelling sales story around the Detroit launch, clearly articulating the commercial opportunity for exhibitors and the value of joining the event from its first edition.
* Use the track record, exhibitor community and success of the European all about automation portfolio to build credibility with US prospects.
* Understand the characteristics of the Detroit and wider Midwest manufacturing market and translate these into persuasive commercial conversations.
* Develop knowledge of the automotive, machinery, plastics, electronics, robotics and advanced manufacturing sectors that make Michigan and the Midwest an important market for industrial automation.
* Gather market intelligence from customers and prospects and feed this back into the wider event strategy.
* Identify potential barriers to participation and work creatively with the wider team to overcome them.
* Help establish all about automation as a credible new meeting place for the US automation and manufacturing community.

### Pipeline Management & Commercial Performance

* Take full ownership of your sales pipeline, ensuring sufficient volume and quality of opportunities to achieve revenue targets.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including prospect activity, next actions, opportunity values and expected close dates.
* Forecast revenue accurately and proactively identify gaps against target.
* Prioritise opportunities effectively and maintain momentum across a high volume of prospects.
* Use data and conversion metrics to understand performance and continuously improve sales activity.
* Negotiate confidently and commercially while protecting the value of the event proposition.
* Work independently and use initiative to identify new routes to market and opportunities for growth.

### US Market Engagement, Travel & Industry Networking

* **Regularly work US-aligned hours to ensure effective contact with prospects, customers and partners across relevant US time zones.**
* **Be willing and able to travel to the United States as required**, potentially several times during the sales cycle and particularly around key industry events and the show itself.
* Attend relevant US automation, robotics, engineering and manufacturing trade shows and industry events to identify prospects and build relationships.
* Proactively approach and pitch prospective exhibitors face-to-face at competitive and complementary events.
* Travel for customer meetings, networking opportunities and other commercial activity where face-to-face engagement will help accelerate sales.
* Represent all about automation professionally and confidently as an ambassador for the brand in the US market.
* Build a strong personal network within the US industrial automation and manufacturing community.
* Attend and play an active commercial role onsite at the launch of all about automation Detroit.
* Where appropriate, visit established all about automation events in Europe to deepen product knowledge, meet existing exhibitors and understand the event experience first-hand.

### Collaboration & Launch Delivery

* Work closely with the wider all about automation and Easyfairs teams to deliver a successful US launch.
* Collaborate with marketing to identify target audiences, develop campaigns and generate high-quality sales opportunities.
* Share customer feedback and market intelligence to help shape messaging, positioning and future growth strategy.
* Work with operations and customer success teams to ensure a smooth exhibitor journey from sale through to event delivery.
* Build strong working relationships with colleagues across international Easyfairs teams, sharing best practice and learning from established all about automation markets.
* Take personal ownership for the success of the launch and contribute beyond the immediate sales remit when required.

* Securing a high-quality founding exhibitor base for the inaugural Detroit event.
* Converting cold prospects into engaged customers and advocates for all about automation.

* Track grid connection milestones, agreements and programme dependencies.
* Assist with land, planning and technical matters relating to substations, cable routes and associated infrastructure.

* Assist in preparing projects for construction, including tracking outstanding land, planning and grid requirements.

* Understanding of UK planning processes and the NSIP consenting framework.
* Experience coordinating consultants, stakeholders or project activities.
* Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, track progress and meet deadlines.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to learn and take on responsibility.

**Desirable:**

* Experience with landowner negotiations, land agreements or agricultural land matters.
* Knowledge of grid connection processes and infrastructure.
* Experience supporting planning applications, environmental assessments or consenting activities.
* Familiarity with DCO projects or planning condition discharge.
* Understanding of the development-to-construction transition.

**Skills Required:**

**Planning & Technical:**

* Awareness of DCO / NSIP consenting & compliance
* Understanding of discharge of requirements management
* Knowledge of environmental management plans (CEMP etc)
* Understanding of Agricultural & rural land matters
* Experience with planning legislation
* Experience with condition / obligation tracking systems
* Knowledge of BNG & ecological mitigation delivery
* Understanding of grid & infrastructure consenting

**Relationship & Commercial:**

* Experience with landowner & tenant management
* Experience with supply chain coordination
* Experience with stakeholder & community engagement
* Experience with negotiation & dispute resolution
* Influencing without direct authority
* Excellent written reporting to board level
* Experieince with construction programme and MS project awareness
* Experience with risk identification & escalation

**Relationship & Commercial**

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Town Planning, Geography, Environmental Science, Land Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Chartered membership of the RTPI, RICS, or equivalent professional body is strongly preferred.
* Full UK driving licence — regular travel to site and landowner meetings is a core requirement of this role.
* Postgraduate qualification in planning, environmental management, or project management is advantageous.

* Healthcare plan, life assurance and generous pension contribution
* Volunteering Day
* Hybrid Working
* Various company discounts (including shops, gyms, days out and events)
* Holiday of 25 days (plus bank holidays) & ability to buy/sell days
* Cycle to work scheme, car pooling and onsite parking available

Company Description
Work smart, have fun and make an impact!
EcoVadis is the leading provider of business sustainability ratings. Our solutions are backed by an international team of experts and powerful technology. We analyze data and build sustainability scorecards that give companies actionable insights into their environmental, social and ethical risks.
Why apply to EcoVadis? Be a part of the global sustainability change in business. Grow your career. Work with extraordinary people. Feel valued for your contribution.
Learn more about our team and culture on EcoVadis careers page. Job Description
As a Senior Product Manager for one of our Strategic Use Cases, you will own that use case end-to-end — from the customer problem and the data it depends on, through prototype, roadmap and launch, to the outcome in the market. You will work alongside senior engineers and product experts to define the ambition, understand requirements and launch innovative new products.
This is a builder role, not a coordination role. We're looking for a high-agency generalist who prototypes before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, engages customers directly, and takes full ownership of outcomes — not output. What you'll be doing
Own the vision: Set and drive the aligned, end-to-end vision for your use case (regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization or resilience)— what the customer experience should be, where the gaps are, and the sequence from parity to leadership. Understand the market: Understand the technical requirements of your use case, and how other competitors and customers are currently solving it. Take inspiration from everywhere, including partner discussions, conferences, webinars and other resources.
Engage customers directly: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Validate problems and solutions first-hand; and build interest from customers and prospects.
Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools to build working demos, spin up lightweight services and test your own assumptions before committing engineering. Show the team what's possible by doing it, not describing it.
Drive the build forward: Work alongside engineering to unblock and drive the build forward, working across multiple areas of the product and platform, collaborating with other tribes and squads whilst executing independently or in partnership.
Partner on go-to-market: Work hand-in-hand with the Strategic Use Case Leads and commercial teams to land what you build.
Own the outcome: Define the measures of success, hold yourself and the circle to them, and lead clean persist / pivot / stop decisions.
Who you are
A generalist builder at heart — you move fluidly between strategy, data, prototype and GTM, and you'd rather build a rough thing that teaches you something than debate a perfect thing that doesn't.
An AI-native operator — AI is woven through how you work: discovery, analysis, prototyping, instrumentation and communication.
Customer-obsessed — you get your conviction from talking to real customers, not from the building.
Biased to speed — you move decisively with incomplete information, tell reversible decisions from irreversible ones, and update fast when you're wrong. Strong opinions, loosely held.
Comfortable without full control — part of your use case's scope and experience will always be owned by other squads. You see managing that, as the craft.
Mission-driven — you want your work to help guide all companies toward a sustainable world, and to help EcoVadis lead the market in getting there.
AI fluency we hire for
We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum: you don't just use AI for one-off tasks, you reconstruct core PM workflows around it — agents configured with your product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows you share with the squad. At the top of this ladder, the PM shifts from feature author to outcome orchestrator — concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis. Qualifications
Typically 10+ years experience, including a track record owning a meaningful product area end-to-end in B2B enterprise SaaS, with real business and customer outcomes to point to.

About the Role

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

As Design & Engineering Lead, you will provide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the engineering, design, and technical governance functions across the National Highways Area 5 network, including the M25 and supporting trunk roads.

This role is responsible for defining and executing the engineering and design strategy that supports the safe, compliant, efficient, and sustainable management of one of the UK's most complex strategic road networks. Leading a multidisciplinary organisation, you will drive excellence in design delivery, asset stewardship, innovation, and technical assurance while ensuring alignment with customer objectives, regulatory requirements, and long-term investment plans.

The position provides oversight across all engineering and design portfolios, including Structures, Linear Assets (Pavements and Geotechnics), Tunnels M&E, Network Technology (including Street Lighting and Traffic Signals), CAD and Digital Engineering. You will lead and develop a team of specialist design engineers and design managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on safety, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

A key aspect of the role is the strategic management of engineering activities across multiple business streams, including Capital Renewals, Maintenance, Design & Build (PDA), and National Highways Improvement Schemes. You will hold budget responsibility for the engineering and design across the business, ensuring effective workforce planning, resource utilisation, capability development, and supply chain engagement. A key expectation of the role is to identify and implement advances in technology, digital engineering, data analytics, and automation to improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and drive continuous improvement throughout the asset lifecycle.

As the senior engineering authority for the business, you will be accountable for ensuring that all design activities are delivered safely, predictably, and in full compliance with applicable standards, legislation, and client requirements. This includes maintaining a comprehensive understanding of asset management strategies, long-term investment programmes, whole-life asset performance, scheme affordability, and contractual handback obligations. You will champion a whole-life asset management approach, ensuring that engineering solutions maximise asset performance and service life while minimising cost, risk, carbon impact, and disruption to the travelling public. Through robust governance processes, design assurance reviews, and early contractor involvement, you will promote the principles of Safety by Design, Design for Maintenance, constructability, and innovation across all stages of project development and delivery. The role carries overall accountability for fulfilling Principal Designer duties under CDM Regulations and ensuring that health, safety, and risk management considerations are fully embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle

As a recognised technical leader, you will maintain oversight of technical approvals, delegated authorities, and engineering assurance processes across all permanent works disciplines. You will ensure that technical governance frameworks remain effective, proportionate, and aligned with industry best practice.

The position requires strong stakeholder leadership, working closely with National Highways, Connect Plus, Framework Contractor partners, external consultants, regulatory bodies, and senior internal stakeholders to establish strategic alignment, influence investment decisions, and ensure the successful delivery of programme objectives.

In addition to leading planned investment activities, you will provide senior engineering leadership during network incidents and emergency response situations, directing technical decision-making and recovery strategies for damaged infrastructure assets and supporting the resilience of the wider network.

The role also provides strategic oversight of engineering surveys, digital asset management, and geospatial modelling, ensuring that high-quality data and emerging technologies are leveraged to support informed decision-making, future investment planning, and enhanced network performance.

Key Accountabilities

* Develop and deliver the engineering and design strategy for the National Highways Area 5 network.
* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary engineering and design teams, driving a culture of excellence, innovation, and accountability.
* Act as the senior technical authority for engineering governance, assurance, and compliance.
* Ensure safe and compliant delivery of all design activities while meeting commercial, operational, and customer objectives.
* Lead strategic planning and prioritisation of engineering resources across multiple programmes and funding streams.
* Drive continuous improvement through digital transformation, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies.
* Maintain accountability for Principal Designer (CDM) responsibilities across the portfolio.

* Optimise whole-life asset performance while balancing risk, cost, sustainability, and customer impact.
* Lead engineering support for incident response, resilience planning, and emergency recovery operations.
* Oversee engineering survey strategies, asset intelligence, and geospatial modelling capabilities.
* Manage engineering budgets, workforce capability, succession planning, and organisational development.

Leadership Expectations

* Strategic and commercial leadership.
* Executive stakeholder engagement and influencing.
* Organisational capability development and succession planning.
* Technical governance and risk management.
* Financial accountability and resource optimisation.
* Innovation, digital transformation, and continuous improvement.
* Customer-focused decision making and operational excellence.

**DIMENSIONS**

**FINANCIAL responsibility:**

This role is responsible for design & engineering management across several hundred interventions each year, ranging in scale and complexity, totally c.£150m of annual construction cost.

The annual design forecast is ~£8-10m, split across internal design team staff costs and external design consultancy spend.

**ORGANISATIONAL responsibility:**

The role will lead the Design & Engineering design team, comprised of c45 design engineers and design team managers.

Several schemes are supported by external design resources to suit the workload requirements and the role manages performance of these strategic design partners.

**INTERFACES**

**INTERNAL:**

Asset Delivery Leads,Asset & Network Planning function (specifically Asset Investment and Technical Authority Teams), CPS Senior Leadership Team, Design & Engineering team members.

**EXTERNAL:**

Senior leaders from supply chain designers, other M25 Community members (particularly Framework contractors working for Connect Plus), National Highways stakeholders and external stakeholders

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Ensure that Safety by Design principles, risk elimination, and behavioural safety expectations are consistently applied across all engineering activities. # Scientist/Senior Scientist, Mass Spectrometry - Generative Biology Institute
