# Head of Talent Management and Insight

To lead the strategic delivery of Talent Insight and Management across Welsh rugby, establishing and embedding a clear and uniquely Welsh DNA for how players are unearthed, understood, connected and developed across the men’s and women’s performance systems.

The role is accountable for defining and delivering an integrated Player Intelligence System and national player pipeline, bringing together expert judgement, scouting, data science, AI and human factors to build a holistic and longitudinal understanding of player performance, potential and progression.

Through modern player trajectory modelling, agentic workflows and evidence-led decision-making, the role will continually improve Welsh rugby’s ability to identify, retain, develop and accelerate future international players, providing coaches and executive leaders with the intelligence to make better player and talent decisions.

**Salary:** **Competitive**

**Closing Date: 29th October 2026**

**The Person**

* Significant senior experience within elite sport, talent, performance intelligence, data science, player development or another relevant high-performance environment.

* Demonstrable experience of developing and implementing strategy across complex, multidisciplinary performance systems.

* Deep understanding of talent identification, talent development and player progression, including the complexity, uncertainty and non-linear nature of predicting future performance.

* Strong understanding of modern data science, predictive modelling and longitudinal player analysis, with the ability to translate technical approaches into meaningful performance questions and decisions.

* Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, automation and agentic systems, with the ability to identify where these technologies can transform scouting, intelligence and performance workflows.

# Rugby AI Lead

Lead the application of artificial intelligence, data science and advanced analytics across Talent Insight & Management, creating new ways to understand player performance, potential, development and progression across Welsh rugby.

The role will combine modern data science with generative and agentic AI to build longitudinal player models, identify emerging talent and changing trajectories, automate intelligence workflows and develop tools that strengthen human judgement and decision-making.

A central responsibility will be developing a secure agentic AI capability and digital workforce for Talent Insight & Management. This will move beyond individual AI tools towards interconnected agents capable of undertaking appropriate elements of research, monitoring, data gathering, video and scouting workflows, player tracking, quality assurance, analysis and intelligence preparation, while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

The role will continually explore and apply emerging approaches across AI, machine learning, predictive modelling and decision science, translating technological advances into practical applications capable of creating sustainable competitive advantage for Welsh rugby.

**The Role**

* Lead AI and data science across Talent Insight & Management, translating strategic rugby and talent questions into analytical models, AI capabilities and practical decision-support tools.

* Develop longitudinal player intelligence, connecting historical and current information across identification, pathway, professional and international rugby to understand how players develop over time.

* Build player trajectory and potential models using statistical modelling, machine learning, time-series and other appropriate techniques to understand changing trajectories, probability of progression and future international potential.

* Develop predictive indicators of future performance, exploring the interaction between technical, tactical, physical, behavioural, maturation, opportunity, exposure and contextual factors.

* Create an agentic AI workforce capable of securely undertaking appropriate elements of data gathering, research, monitoring, video and scouting workflows, player tracking, quality assurance, reporting and intelligence preparation for human review.

* Develop and productionise advanced statistical and machine-learning models, ensuring models are appropriately validated, monitored and continually improved as new evidence becomes available.

* Translate complex analysis into decision-ready intelligence, creating intuitive visualisations, tools and outputs that allow coaches and senior leaders to understand player potential, uncertainty, development priorities, opportunities and risk.

As the Manager - Digital Tax Compliance, you will be responsible for leading and supporting global e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital tax compliance initiatives. You will provide tax expertise and oversight for global implementations while monitoring evolving regulatory requirements, strengthening tax data governance, and supporting continuous improvement of scalable tax technology processes across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and the Record-to-Report cycles.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the global tax subject matter expert for e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital tax compliance requirements.
* Monitor emerging global e-invoicing and digital reporting mandates, including PEPPOL, ViDA, KSeF, SDI, CFDI, NF-e, ZATCA, SAF-T, and comparable country frameworks, and assess impacts on business processes, systems, invoice data, and compliance obligations.

* Lead global e-invoicing tax workstreams, including roadmap execution, deliverables, risks, dependencies, stakeholder governance, issue escalation, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Support tax data governance and control monitoring by establishing reporting validation, reconciliation, exception-management, and audit-ready documentation standards.
* Identify tax compliance risks, control gaps, and process impacts, and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
* Provide tax compliance guidance, issue resolution, and tax sign-off for e-invoicing and digital reporting implementations and system changes.
* Maintain global e-invoicing compliance documentation, requirements repositories, and implementation standards while supporting continuous improvement and standardization initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors Degree in Accounting, finance or related field is required; Masters Degree is preferred.
* 6 years required, 8 years preferred of indirect tax, VAT, GST, tax technology, or tax transformation experience in a multinational organization or public accounting environment.
* 6 years required, 8 years preferred of supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, digital reporting, or related tax compliance initiatives., including demonstrated experience with multinational implementations and major continuous transaction control or clearance regimes.
* 3 years required, 5 years preferred of gathering, documenting, and translating tax and regulatory requirements into business and system requirements.
* 3 years required, 5 years preferred of leading cross-functional tax technology workstreams, managing implementation risks and dependencies, and coordinating internal and external resources in support of enterprise-wide ERP or other systems initiatives and Finance transformation initiatives
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, complete work timely and accurately, and work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong organizational, analytical, documentation, and problem solving, project leadership, data analysis, and risk management skills.
* Strong understanding of indirect tax concepts, including VAT, GST, sales and use tax, and invoice compliance requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management, written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across Tax, IT, Finance, and Operations teams.
* Proficiency with Jira, Microsoft Office applications, and tax technology platforms; experience with ERP systems (Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and tax engines (ONESOURCE, Vertex, Avalara or similar) preferred, e-invoicing platforms or service providers (such as EDICOM, Sovos, Pagero, or similar), PEPPOL access-point models, middleware, and API-based integrations preferred.

## Job Introduction

We’re on the lookout for a **Housing Officer** to come join us for a**12 month fixed term contract**to help us deliver a quality, customer‐obsessed service across our communities covering **South and West Yorkshire**. You’ll be out and about most of the time, acting as a visible and trusted Yorkshire Housing colleague - spotting what matters, joining the dots with partners and making sure customers get the right advice at the right time.

**What you’ll do**

* **Welcome new customers well.** Deliver a customer‐obsessed lettings experience: pre‐tenancy support, viewings and sign‐ups that set people up for success.
* **Give clear, practical guidance.** Provide pre‐tenancy information (including financial products and welfare benefits) and promote *rent on time* in a straight‐talking, supportive way.
* **Onboard with care.** Help new customers settle in and sort any early issues quickly and fairly.
* **Spot who needs extra support.** Identify vulnerable customers and refer to the right internal/external help.
* **Be our eyes and ears.** Spend most of your time in our places—building relationships, picking up insights that shape local plans, and making sure customers get timely info and guidance.

**What you’ll bring**

* Customer obsession, you’ll have a  proven track record of putting customers first and balancing empathy with fair, consistent decision‐making.
* Experience across the tenancy lifecycle (lettings, sign‐ups, settling‐in, tenancy changes, sustainment and endings).
* Triage multiple priorities, plan your day and adapt quickly when things change.
* Clear, kind, communication—face to face, by phone and in writing—with the ability to handle difficult conversations professionally.
* You’ll be a pro at partnership working, you’ll build strong working relationships with colleagues, local partners and agencies to get the right outcomes first time.
* Ability to maintain and understand the importance of accurate records and case notes, using the right systems and following our policies and SLAs.
* Ability to work out in our communities across Yorkshire, this will mean lots of travel!

It would be a bonus if you had...

* Experience in social housing, community‐based services or a similar customer‐facing role.
* Working knowledge of key housing areas (tenancy management, safeguarding, equality, data protection) and the spirit of the Housing Ombudsman’s Complaint Handling Code.
* CIH membership/qualification or a commitment to work towards one.

Don’t meet every single desirable? If you have the core essentials and the right mindset, we’d still love to hear from you. Check out the attached Role Profile for full info on the role.

**Why apply?**

This a full-time (35 hours per week) 12 month opportunity with a salary of **£****34,532.23 plus** **£2,000 car allowance** per year, plus 26 days annual leave (rising annually to 31 days) plus Bank Holidays.

We offer a reward package to suit everyone. At YH, you can claim back for prescriptions, eye tests and more with our cash plan, make the most of a variety of retail discounts and take advantage of our pension scheme where we’ll match your contributions up to 9%, just to name a few.

Our people’s health and wellbeing are one of our top priorities, and you can make the most of our readily available wellbeing support package. This includes access to a library of free fitness classes, as well as an instant My GP service and free counselling sessions with a trained professional.

If you’re applying for this role internally, you must inform your current line manager (it’s the right thing to do!).  

**So, now you’re really interested?**

At YH, we’re actively building a work environment that’s inclusive as well as diverse. We believe difference is what makes us stronger and recognise the importance of our teams reflecting the communities we serve, so we welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds for this role.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Water Quality Scientist - Potable** to join the Water Quality team at Yorkshire Water and be a part of helping Yorkshire Water to provide the best service to our customers. **Could this be you?**

**What we do!**

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. Here in Yorkshire, we make sure that over 5.4 million people living in the region and the millions of people who visit our region each year, can rely on our services, and have clean and safe drinking water on tap and that their wastewater is taken away. But for us, it's so much more than this.

We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire's water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region's health, wellbeing, and prosperity.

New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. Water Production are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.

This is a vital role, as you will be providing the best customer service and resolution to water quality related contacts. You will optimise, assets, systems, processes, and procedures in line with continuous improvement in water quality performance and protection of public health at all times both (water distribution and production sites). You will work towards minimising water quality related contacts and to help deliver our vision of taking responsibility for the water environment for good.

**Where you fit in!**

**As our Water Quality Scientist – Potable you will;**

•    You will lead a co-ordinated, planned and effective response to incidents across the business, and to ensure that processes, procedures are followed and agreed actions or requirements are implemented.

•    You will prepare reports for submission to our regulator/Senior Managers and investigatory reports and review of exception reports provided by the team of scientists.

•    You will ensure compliance with our Performance Commitments - specifically the Compliance Risk Index (CRI), the Event Risk Index (ERI), Customer Contacts and Unplanned Outage (UPO) commitments.

•    You will undertake the role of water quality consultant on a 1 in 5-week basis providing water quality support within water quality and across the business and to external stakeholders. You will support and deliver key initiatives and projects in relation to Water Quality Compliance, Customer Contacts, Network, Production and Capital support.

•    Once fully trained you will be part of the water quality standby rota on a minimum 1 week in 5 frequency. Providing expert support and advice on behalf of the Water Quality Manager to field, Asset Management, the Duty Manger and the wider business as required. 

**What skills & qualifications you will need:**

•    The successful candidate will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of water quality processes and regulatory obligations, water treatment and distribution processes.

•    You will be able to deal with incidents and events to protect public health and to minimise impacts on water quality compliance.

•    You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills this includes both written report writing and verbally.

•    You will be able to solve problems often under pressure and to deadlines.

•    You will have strong analytical skills and be able to fault find processes and systems.

•    You will be able to handle large amounts of diverse data and to spot potential risks to compliance.

•    You will have a can-do attitude with not only an ability to plan for the future but a capability to deal effectively with the unforeseen.

•    You will have excellent influencing and networking skills to build relationships with key stakeholders at all levels within Yorkshire Water, service partner organisations and with external key stakeholders. You will consider health and safety at all times and support a zero accident culture. You will be comfortable using a range of IT systems.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Xylem is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to lead the successful delivery of complex temporary pumping, bypass and dewatering projects across the UK water and utilities sector. In this role you will be working alongside leading Tier 1 contractors and major utility clients including Anglian Water, Severn Trent Water and other key framework customers, you will take ownership of projects from initial handover through mobilisation, installation, operation and final demobilisation.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Project Engineer looking to take a leading role in delivering critical infrastructure projects that directly support the operation and maintenance of essential water and wastewater networks.

You will work at the interface between engineering, operations, commercial teams and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on programme and within budget.

  

Project Delivery

·       Manage and coordinate the delivery of pump rental, bypass pumping and temporary works projects from award through to completion.

·       Act as the primary project lead between customers, operations teams, engineering teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

·       Develop and maintain project programmes, resource plans and delivery schedules.

·       Coordinate all mobilisation activities including plant, equipment, labour, transport, lifting operations, electrical installations and site access requirements.

·       Monitor project performance, identify risks and implement mitigation measures to maintain programme and budget objectives.

·       Provide regular project updates to customers, internal stakeholders and senior management.

·       Manage project close-out activities, capturing lessons learned and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  

Customer & Stakeholder Management

·       Build strong relationships with Tier 1 contractors, water companies and key framework customers.

·       Attend client meetings, design reviews, planning sessions and site progress meetings.

·       Ensure customer requirements are fully understood and translated into successful project delivery plans.

·       Act as a trusted technical and operational contact throughout the project lifecycle.

·       Support business growth through the delivery of exceptional customer service and project performance.

  

Technical Leadership

·       Review project requirements and ensure proposed pumping solutions are practical, safe and commercially viable.

·       Provide technical oversight during the planning and delivery of temporary pumping installations.

·       Work closely with electrical, mechanical and temporary works specialists to develop robust project solutions.

·       Support technical reviews covering pump selection, generators, variable speed drives, control systems, pipelines, lifting operations and associated temporary works.

·       Resolve technical issues that arise during project execution.

  

Commercial & Contract Management

·       Monitor project costs, utilisation and expenditure against approved budgets.

·       Support forecasting, reporting and project financial performance reviews.

·       Manage variations, compensation events and project changes where applicable.

·       Ensure commercial risks and opportunities are identified and managed effectively.

·       Maintain a strong understanding of NEC contracts and project delivery obligations.

  

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality

·       Ensure projects are delivered in full compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

·       Lead project planning activities, including RAMS reviews, project documentation and risk assessments.

·       Promote a positive safety culture across project teams and supply chain partners.

·       Ensure all project personnel and subcontractors operate to required competency and compliance standards.

·       Drive continual improvement in safety, quality and operational performance.

**Skills & Experience**

  

Essential

·       Proven experience as a Project Engineer delivering infrastructure, utility, construction, temporary works or pump rental projects.

·       Experience working directly with Tier 1 contractors and utility companies.

·       Strong understanding of project delivery, planning and coordination principles.

·       Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, engineering and commercial functions.

·       Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.

·       Demonstrable experience managing project risks, resources and programme requirements.

·       Knowledge of RAMS, site safety requirements and CDM principles.

·       Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project profitability.

Desirable

·       Experience delivering temporary pumping, bypass pumping or dewatering projects.

·       Experience within the UK water sector.

·       Knowledge of NEC3 and NEC4 contracts.

·       Electrical or mechanical engineering background.

·       SMSTS, IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent qualification.

·       APM, PRINCE2 or similar project management qualification.

·       Experience managing subcontractors and specialist suppliers.

What We're Looking For

  

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Project Engineer who can confidently lead projects, build credibility with customers and deliver successful outcomes in challenging operational environments.

The ideal candidate will already have experience working within utilities, infrastructure, water, temporary works or pump rental sectors and will be comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, tight programmes and demanding customer expectations.

Why Join Xylem?

  

·       Deliver high-profile projects for major UK water utilities and Tier 1 contractors.

·       Work on critical infrastructure programmes that support essential public services.

·       Join an industry-leading provider of pumping and water technology solutions.

·       Opportunity to progress into Senior Project Engineer, Project Manager and Programme Management roles.

·       Be part of a business investing heavily in growth across the UK utilities and rental markets.

  

*Typical Clients*

·       Anglian Water

·       Severn Trent Water

·       Yorkshire Water

·       United Utilities

·       Thames Water

·       Southern Water

·       Major Tier 1 contractors operating across AMP programmes and capital delivery frameworks
